author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager
job_description:
**Company:**
------------

Qualcomm India Private Limited

**Job Area:**
-------------

Operations Group, Operations Group > Product Management

**General Summary:**

Directs a comprehensive product strategy from product conception and definition through end of life. Functions as a central resource with design, process, manufacturing, quality, test, marketing, and distribution as the product(s) and/or product line(s) move through their lifecycle. Formulates and executes long-term roadmaps for cost/profit control. Promotes use of new technologies and industry-leading trends. Directs those involved in the design, modification, and evaluation of all phases of a specific product or group of products. Involvement lasts throughout all stages of a product’s lifecycle including modifications, upgrades, and maintenance of the product or product line.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or technical related field.
* 2+ years of Product Management or related work experience.

  

* Completed advanced degrees in a relevant field may be substituted for up to two years (Master’s = one year, Doctorate = two years) of work experience.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of Product Management or related work experience.

* 1+ year of working in a large matrixed organization.

* 1+ year of working with operating budgets and/or project financials.

* 1+ year of negotiating 3rd party business agreements.

**Principal Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Conducts analyses to assess marketability of products based on market, customer, technology, and other ecosystem demands.

* Serves as a market and business advisor in the formation of a business case for the development of a new product or product features (i.e., time to market, cost, market share).

* Drives the launch efforts of products and technologies for own area of responsibility by staying up to date on technological developments and customer needs through direct customer contact.

* Seeks out market information and displays an understanding of the marketplace to contribute to the product roadmap.

* Directs the development of moderately complex products and services under some supervision and communicates with individuals across functional teams.

* Completes product development and definition activities including determination of cost and impact, and interacts with sales team to generate forecasts.

* Stays up to date on competitors, technological advances, and product ecosystem and supports the development and design of new products.

* Maintains effective communication within own team and cross-functional team(s) on the management of a single product.

* Ensures successful cross-functional collaboration by ensuring that agreed upon KPIs and specifications are met for a single product, upon delivery by engineering team.
* Supports the establishment of product goals (e.g., performance, cost, timeline) and collaborates with others to execute tasks based on established goals.

**Level of Responsibility:**

* Working under some supervision.

* Making decisions that are low to moderate in impact; errors may have relatively minor financial impact or effect on projects, operations, or customer relationships; errors may require involvement beyond immediate work group to correct.

* Using verbal and written communication skills to convey information that may be somewhat complex to others who may have limited knowledge of the subject in question. May require basic negotiation and influence, cooperation, tact, and diplomacy, etc.

* Completing tasks with multiple steps that can be performed in various orders; some planning and prioritization must occur to complete the tasks effectively; mistakes may result in some rework.

* Exercising creativity to draft original documents, imagery, or work products within established guidelines.

* Using deductive and inductive problem solving; multiple approaches may be taken/necessary to solve the problem; often information is missing or incomplete; intermediate data analysis/interpretation skills may be required.

The responsibilities of this role do not include:

* Financial accountability (e.g., does not involve budgeting responsibility).

* Influence over key organizational decisions.

* Role in strategic planning.

**Applicants** : Qualcomm is an equal opportunity employer. If you are an individual with a disability and need an accommodation during the application/hiring process, rest assured that Qualcomm is committed to providing an accessible process. You may e-mail disability-accomodations@qualcomm.com or call Qualcomm's toll-free number found here . Upon request, Qualcomm will provide reasonable accommodations to support individuals with disabilities to be able participate in the hiring process. Qualcomm is also committed to making our workplace accessible for individuals with disabilities. (Keep in mind that this email address is used to provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities. We will not respond here to requests for updates on applications or resume inquiries).

Qualcomm expects its employees to abide by all applicable policies and procedures, including but not limited to security and other requirements regarding protection of Company confidential information and other confidential and/or proprietary information, to the extent those requirements are permissible under applicable law.

**To all Staffing and Recruiting Agencies** : Our Careers Site is only for individuals seeking a job at Qualcomm. Staffing and recruiting agencies and individuals being represented by an agency are not authorized to use this site or to submit profiles, applications or resumes, and any such submissions will be considered unsolicited. Qualcomm does not accept unsolicited resumes or applications from agencies. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, Qualcomm employees or any other company location. Qualcomm is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes/applications.

If you would like more information about this role, please contact Qualcomm Careers .

title: Lead Technical Product Manager, ITC
job_description:
Position Type

Full Time

Career area

Program, Product & Project Management

Location

4/F, WeWork, Embassy GolfLinks, Karnataka, Karnātaka 560093, India

Job ID

R-96314

Become a Part of the NIKE, Inc. Team

NIKE, Inc. does more than outfit the world’s best athletes. It is a place to explore potential, obliterate boundaries and push out the edges of what can be. The company looks for people who can grow, think, dream and create. Its culture thrives by embracing diversity and rewarding imagination. The brand seeks achievers, leaders and visionaries. At NIKE, Inc. it’s about each person bringing skills and passion to a challenging and constantly evolving game.

**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH**

This role reports to the Manager, Software Engineering, within Global Procurement Technology at the India Technology Center (ITC) in Bangalore.

The ITC team supports global procurement and corporate functions, enabling NIKE to operate efficiently and at scale across regions. As the lead technical program manager for indirect procurement, you will own the end-to-end program strategy for Source-to-Pay (S2P) solutions and coach TPMs who execute roadmaps for individual product areas.

Successful delivery and operational excellence in this role depend on close collaboration with:

* Senior TPMs, software engineers, architects, analysts, and business partners across indirect procurement products such as Coupa, Tririga, Beeline, Concur, Aravo, and related SaaS platforms
* Core ERP teams (SAP S/4HANA, ECC, and Oracle) covering accounts payable, tax, and related domains
* Engineering, security, and enterprise architecture partners
* External SaaS vendors and technology partners
  

  
  

**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

We are seeking a seasoned technical program leader with deep expertise in procurement processes and platforms, particularly integrating sourcing and procurement SaaS with SAP (ECC and S/4HANA). The successful candidate combines hands-on S2P and P2P knowledge with proven ability to define multi-horizon roadmaps, lead TPMs, and influence senior business and technology stakeholders in a global enterprise.

  

In this role, you will own product vision and roadmap articulation, portfolio prioritization, program governance, and delivery cadence across scrum teams. You will facilitate workshops and design discussions at the portfolio level, validate requirements and solution approaches, mentor senior and junior TPMs, and partner with procurement leadership to deliver scalable, audit-ready capabilities worldwide.

  

This position is based in Bangalore, India. We welcome applications from candidates currently residing in Bangalore as well as those willing to relocate.
  
**Required Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8+ years in software engineering, technical program management, or product delivery with a strong focus on procurement processes and platforms, including hands-on experience integrating multiple indirect procurement tools with SAP (ECC and S/4HANA).
* Demonstrated leadership of TPMs or cross-functional delivery teams across P2P and S2P products, SaaS-based procurement systems, and ERP master and transactional data flows.
* Expertise in integration strategy—source-to-target mapping, payload design, transformations, and patterns spanning APIs, events, batch/file, and middleware—with ability to guide architects and engineers.
* Proficiency with portfolio and delivery tools such as Jira, Confluence, and Lucid (or equivalents); experience defining prioritization frameworks and operating rhythms for global programs.
* Exceptional communication and executive presence, with the ability to synthesize complex technical and process topics for business, engineering, and vendor audiences.
* Comfort leading in a fast-paced, results-oriented, global environment with competing priorities and ambiguous problem spaces.
* Strong collaboration skills and a growth mindset: you develop others, model curiosity, and drive continuous improvement across teams and vendors.
  

**WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON**

* You will define and communicate the vision and roadmap for enterprise Source-to-Pay and procurement technology that supports Nike's global indirect procurement operations.
* You will lead portfolio-level prioritization with procurement, finance, and technology leaders—balancing demand, risk, cost, and capability—and drive decisions to clear commitments.
* You will translate strategic intent into phased delivery plans, success metrics, and well-scoped backlogs, guiding teams on out-of-the-box SaaS use versus justified extensions.
* You will mentor and develop TPMs and senior engineers on delivery execution, stakeholder engagement, and program governance.
* You will partner with ERP, security, enterprise architecture, and external SaaS vendors to align solutions with Nike standards, integration patterns, and long-term platform direction.
* You will establish program health metrics, release readiness criteria, and escalation paths so teams deliver predictably across regions.
* You will anticipate regulatory, audit, and operational needs (e.g., SOX, data residency, vendor SLAs) and embed them in roadmap planning.

NIKE, Inc. is a growth company that looks for team members to grow with it. Nike offers a generous total rewards package, casual work environment, a diverse and inclusive culture, and an electric atmosphere for professional development. No matter the location, or the role, every Nike employee shares one galvanizing mission: To bring inspiration and innovation to every athlete\* in the world.

NIKE, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability.

What You Can Expect

**OUR HIRING GAME PLAN**
------------------------

### **01 Apply**

Our teams are made up of diverse skillsets, knowledge bases, inputs, ideas and backgrounds. We want you to find your fit – review job descriptions, departments and teams to discover the role for you.

### **02 Meet a Recruiter or Take an Assessment**

If selected for a corporate role, a recruiter will reach out to start your interview process and be your main contact throughout the process. For retail roles, you’ll complete an interactive assessment that includes a chat and quizzes and takes about 10-20 minutes to complete. No matter the role, we want to learn about you – the whole you – so don’t shy away from how you approach world-class service and what makes you unique.

### **03 Interview**

Go into this stage confident by doing your research, understanding what we are looking for and being prepared for questions that are set up to learn more about you, and your background.

title: Product Manager, Google Cloud Business Platform
job_description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Hyderabad, Telangana, India; Bengaluru, Karnataka, India**.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in product management or a related technical role.
* 2 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end-to-end, 0 to 1, etc).
* 2 years of experience developing/launching products/technologies within one or more of the following: Cloud, SaaS, enterprise, internal tools, or supply chain networks.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience with Quote-to-Cash, Ordering, Fulfillment or Supply Chain Product Management.
* Experience in Platform Product Management.
* Knowledge of Ordering and Fulfillment Processes and Systems for Hardware or Software.
* Strong product management, business acumen, investigative, and stakeholder management skills, with exceptional attention to detail.
* Strong problem solving, data analysis and business judgment skills.

**About the job**
-----------------

At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
  
  
In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.  
  
One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

  

The OREO (Ordering, Entitlements and Obligations) team powers Google Cloud's commercial success by managing order booking and product fulfillment orchestration. Part of GCBP (Google Cloud Business Platform), we are modernizing the Quote-to-Cash life-cycle—from ordering and provisioning to billing—ensuring data quality across Cloud's financial, sales compensation, and transaction systems. We offer a collaborative, culture focused on major architectural upgrades and high-stakes initiatives.

As a team member, you will manage the migration to Cloud's automated booking and orchestration platform, launching new agreement types, products, and Go-To-Market (GTM) motions to reshape the post-agreement experience for customers and internal teams. We provide growth opportunities, empowering Product Managers to direct high-visibility programs and strategic integrations alongside talented peers. Join us to solve tests and impact Google Cloud's commerce platform.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Lead the product roadmap for core ordering systems, modernizing and automating Google Cloud's Quote-to-Cash life-cycle across offline and online flows.
* Design and execute end-to-end orchestration workflows for product provisioning and manage platform primitives for entitlement life-cycles and usage integration metrics.
* Drive cross-functional alignment with engineering, sales operations, and boundary product groups to support commercial transaction flows and downstream systems like sales compensation, billing, and business recognition.
* Serve as the Subject Matter Expert and advocate for process/system discipline in ordering, booking, and fulfillment for your supported line of business.
* Lead end-to-end initiatives across Quote-to-Cash and GCBP overall.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

* 2 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end-to-end, 0 to 1, etc).
* 2 years of experience developing/launching products/technologies within one or more of the following: Cloud, SaaS, enterprise, internal tools, or supply chain networks.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience with Quote-to-Cash, Ordering, Fulfillment or Supply Chain Product Management.
* Experience in Platform Product Management.
* Knowledge of Ordering and Fulfillment Processes and Systems for Hardware or Software.
* Strong product management, business acumen, investigative, and stakeholder management skills, with exceptional attention to detail.
* Strong problem solving, data analysis and business judgment skills.

**About the job**
-----------------

At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
  
  
In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.  
  
One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

  

The OREO (Ordering, Entitlements and Obligations) team powers Google Cloud's commercial success by managing order booking and product fulfillment orchestration. Part of GCBP (Google Cloud Business Platform), we are modernizing the Quote-to-Cash life-cycle—from ordering and provisioning to billing—ensuring data quality across Cloud's financial, sales compensation, and transaction systems. We offer a collaborative, culture focused on major architectural upgrades and high-stakes initiatives.

As a team member, you will manage the migration to Cloud's automated booking and orchestration platform, launching new agreement types, products, and Go-To-Market (GTM) motions to reshape the post-agreement experience for customers and internal teams. We provide growth opportunities, empowering Product Managers to direct high-visibility programs and strategic integrations alongside talented peers. Join us to solve tests and impact Google Cloud's commerce platform.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Lead the product roadmap for core ordering systems, modernizing and automating Google Cloud's Quote-to-Cash life-cycle across offline and online flows.
* Design and execute end-to-end orchestration workflows for product provisioning and manage platform primitives for entitlement life-cycles and usage integration metrics.
* Drive cross-functional alignment with engineering, sales operations, and boundary product groups to support commercial transaction flows and downstream systems like sales compensation, billing, and business recognition.
* Serve as the Subject Matter Expert and advocate for process/system discipline in ordering, booking, and fulfillment for your supported line of business.
* Lead end-to-end initiatives across Quote-to-Cash and GCBP overall.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

job_description:
Meet the Team
  
  
Webex Customer Experience Solutions is shaping the future of customer experience by helping organizations deliver connected, intelligent, and trusted interactions at scale. We build modern, intuitive, and efficient experiences for agents, supervisors, operators, and analysts by bringing together AI, automation, data, and human-centered design.
  
  
Across the United States, Europe, and Asia, we partner with Engineering, Design, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Solution Consulting, and Operations. We are customer-obsessed, collaborative, curious, and high ownership: we move with urgency, learn continuously, challenge the status quo, and support one another in turning ambitious ideas into meaningful products.
  
  
Your impact
  
  
As a Product Manager, you will deliver a defined set of product features or a focused workstream within Webex Customer Experience Solutions. You will work with your manager and senior product partners to understand customer problems, translate priorities into requirements and success measures, and coordinate delivery with Engineering, UX, and other teams. You will monitor results after launch, share customer and usage insights, recommend improvements, and escalate risks early.
  
  
Responsibilities
  
  

* Work with customers, partners, and field teams to understand customer workflows. Use feedback, usage, support trends, and market signals to validate problems and desired outcomes.
* Contribute to the roadmap and own prioritization for a defined feature set or workstream, in partnership with your manager and senior product leaders. Translate priorities into requirements, success measures, and delivery plans.
* Partner with Engineering, UX, Data, and technical teams to deliver reliable experiences. Clarify tradeoffs and dependencies, track decisions and risks, and raise blockers early with recommendations.
* Support launch readiness, positioning, enablement, documentation, and customer communication with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Support, and Operations. Monitor adoption and quality after launch and use evidence to recommend improvements.
* Use AI tools responsibly to support product discovery, analysis, prototyping, and execution. Share practices that strengthen team collaboration and product quality.

Minimum qualifications
  
  

* Bachelors + 5 years of related experience, or Masters + 3 years of related experience of product management or closely related experience, ideally in enterprise software, SaaS, communications, cloud, or customer experience products.
* Experience delivering a defined feature set or workstream from customer discovery and prioritization through requirements, delivery, launch, and post-launch improvement.
* A customer-centered and data-driven approach to defining problems, prioritizing work, and measuring outcomes.
* Strong ability to influence Engineering, UX, data, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Operations partners in a matrixed environment without direct authority.
* Experience using AI tools in product work, such as synthesizing customer feedback, analyzing product data, exploring concepts, or improving product workflows.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to synthesize customer and stakeholder feedback into clear product requirements and explain product decisions, tradeoffs, risks, and progress to different audiences.
* Technical fluency to understand workflows, integrations, APIs, data, dependencies, and engineering tradeoffs.

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Experience in contact center, CCaaS, digital channels, omnichannel customer experience, communications, or enterprise SaaS products.
* Familiarity with product analytics, experimentation, or AI-enabled customer experiences.
* Experience working with enterprise customers, strategic partners, and globally distributed product and engineering teams.

. May be worth adding 'Be data driven' when it comes to decisions / recommendations / contributions
  
  
Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  
Disclaimer
  
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:
  
  

* be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
* begin with screening or an interview
* originate from a Cisco email address, and
* be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other thanhttps://careers.cisco.com orcisco.wd5.myworkday.com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport.
  
  
If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

title: Product Manager (Mobile-First Consumer Internet)
job_description:
**About the Role:**

We're looking for a hands-on Product Manager with 4–8 years of experience building consumer internet products, ideally mobile-first apps where user engagement, retention, and growth are central to the business.

At FOXO, you'll work directly with the founders, designers, engineers, doctors, and business teams to identify consumer problems, shape product direction, and take ideas from discovery to launch. You'll use customer insights and data to make decisions, improve user experiences, and drive measurable product outcomes.

This isn't a role where you'll inherit a mature roadmap. You'll help build one. We're looking for someone with strong product judgment, an analytical mindset, and the ability to execute independently in a fast-moving startup environment.

**What You'll Do:**

* **Own product initiatives end to end:** Drive problem discovery, prioritization, development, launch, and post-launch improvements.
* **Build great mobile experiences:** Improve onboarding, navigation, user journeys, and the overall experience of using a consumer app.
* **Understand consumer behaviour:** Use customer interviews, feedback, behavioural data, and competitive research to identify opportunities.
* **Drive product direction:** Work with the founders to shape the roadmap and prioritize problems based on customer needs and business impact.
* **Partner with Design and Engineering:** Translate problems into clear user flows, product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* **Use data to drive decisions:** Analyse funnels, cohorts, activation, engagement, and retention to identify drop-offs and opportunities for improvement.
* **Experiment and iterate:** Test ideas, evaluate outcomes, and continuously improve the product based on evidence.
* **Drive execution:** Make trade-offs, resolve bottlenecks, coordinate releases, and maintain a high bar for product quality.
* **Collaborate across teams:** Work with doctors and business teams to translate domain expertise into useful consumer experiences.
* **Explore AI opportunities:** Identify where AI can meaningfully improve the user experience or solve a real consumer problem.

**What We're Looking For:**

Must Have

* 4–8 years of hands-on Product Management experience, preferably in B2C or consumer internet.
* Experience at a consumer internet company building products used directly by consumers, where engagement, retention, or growth mattered.
* Strong understanding of mobile app fundamentals, including onboarding, user journeys, navigation, funnels, and repeat usage.
* Demonstrated ownership of product initiatives from discovery through launch and subsequent iteration.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to use product data and customer insights to make decisions.
* Ability to break down ambiguous problems into clear requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Strong product sense and attention to detail, with an understanding of the trade-offs between user experience, business outcomes, and engineering effort.
* Ability to work directly with founders, make decisions with incomplete information, and drive projects independently.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
* A bachelor's degree from a Tier-I college or other leading undergraduate institution.

Good to Have

* Experience improving activation, conversion, engagement, retention, or other core consumer product metrics.
* Experience building mobile apps in health, wellness, lifestyle, fintech, commerce, or other consumer-focused categories.
* Familiarity with Mixpanel, Amplitude, GA4, PostHog, or similar product analytics tools.
* Working knowledge of SQL.
* Familiarity with Figma, Jira, Notion, and AI-powered productivity tools.
* Experience with AI/LLM-powered products. Prior AI experience is not a requirement.

**Location & Work Model:**

* **Location:** Bengaluru, Karnataka, India.
* **Work Model:** Full-time, on-site at FOXO's Bengaluru office.
* **Relocation:** Candidates currently based outside Bengaluru must be willing to relocate.

**What Success Looks Like:**

* Identifying high-impact consumer problems and turning them into simple, intuitive product experiences.
* Shipping quality mobile experiences with minimal supervision.
* Improving activation, engagement, retention, and other meaningful product metrics.
* Making product decisions grounded in customer behaviour, data, and sound judgment.
* Taking ownership of outcomes rather than simply delivering features.

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* Current location (City)
* Years of experience in Product Management
* Have you worked at a consumer internet or B2C product company?
* What is your current notice period?
* What is your current CTC?
* What is your expected CTC?

Work Location: In person

title: Product Manager
job_description:
**EXCLUSIVE NETWORKS** | **Introduction**

Exclusive Networks is the global cybersecurity go-to-market specialist that provides partners and end-customers with a wide range of services and product portfolios. With offices in over 45 countries and the ability to serve customers in over 170 countries, we combine deep local expertise with the scale and delivery of a single global organization.

Our best-in-class vendor portfolio is carefully curated with all leading industry players. Our services range from managed security to specialist technical accreditation and training and capitalize on rapidly evolving technologies and changing business models. For more information visit www.exclusive-networks.com.

At Exclusive Networks, we are passionate about making a difference. That means delivering the best to our ecosystem, shaping a prosperous and trusted digital world, and helping our people to realize their full potential.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** | **About the role**

The Product Manager is responsible for driving profitable business growth by managing the complete sales lifecycle—from lead qualification to closure—while ensuring strong pipeline hygiene, partner engagement, and alignment with vendor expectations

This role will report to the Business Unit Head

**As the Product Manager, you will:**

1. Sales Pipeline and Funnel Management

* Develop, maintain, and manage a qualified 3X sales funnel aligned with vendor-assigned revenue targets.
* Conduct bi-weekly pipeline reviews with vendor teams to ensure alignment on progress and forecasts.
* Oversee accurate and timely deal registrations, opportunity tracking, and reporting.

2. Lead Management and Customer Engagement

* Qualify leads generated through cold outreach, inbound inquiries, and partner referrals.
* Independently present vendor solutions to prospects, involving senior or technical stakeholders only for executive-level or strategic accounts.

3. Proposal and Solution Support

* Prepare and oversee the creation of competitive quotations and proposals.
* Coordinate proof-of-concepts (POCs), demo units, and other pre-sales engagements to support solution validation.

4. Partner and Vendor Management

* Manage key stakeholders within the business line to ensure effective collaboration and execution.
* Identify, develop, and nurture Focus Partners to drive mutual growth.
* Deliver partner enablement sessions, including updates and training programs.

5. Marketing Collaboration

* Establish measurable objectives for marketing investments and initiatives.
* Collaborate with internal marketing teams and external partners to plan and execute joint campaigns effectively.

6. Certifications and Compliance

* Obtain and maintain all mandatory vendor sales certifications.
* Ensure adherence to organizational governance standards and reporting requirements.

**QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE** | **About you**

**The Product Manager :**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Business, IT, Engineering, or a related field
* Minimum 3+ years of experience in channel sales, preferably in networking or IT solutions
* Proven track record in selling solutions related to Extreme Networks products and services
* Strong understanding of solution selling and partner ecosystem management
* Experience in working with distributors, resellers, and system integrators
* Excellent presentation, negotiation, and communication skills
* Ability to manage complex sales cycles and drive revenue growth
* Self-motivated with strong relationship-building and account management skills

**WHO ARE EXCLUSIVE NETWORKS?** | **Why work for us**

We are people focused and strongly believe that talent empowers us to continue our dynasty of disruption and growth in the future. Our Mission is to drive the transition to a totally trusted digital world for all people and organizations. Visit our website www.exclusive-networks.com.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to the recruitment and hiring of individuals from diverse backgrounds and experiences, as we believe this strengthens our ability to develop superior solutions, make informed decisions, and better serve our valued customers. We do not discriminate against individuals on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, disability status, or any similar characteristic. Employment decisions are made solely on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. Please click here to review our Diversity and Inclusion Policy for further information.

We care about your data: please click here to read our Recruitment Data Protection Policy prior to applying, and therefore sharing your data with us.

If you think the open position you see is right for you, we encourage you to apply!  
Our people make all the difference in our success.

job_description:
**Vacancy Name**

Senior Product Manager - AI

  

**Vacancy No**

VN1077

  

**Job Title**

Senior Product Manager - AI

  

**Work Location City**

Bangalore

  

**About Solifi**

Solifi deliver a solid financial technology foundation for equipment, working capital, wholesale, and automotive finance firms. At Solifi, we believe that commerce is only as strong as the system it runs on. Our mission is to reshape finance technology by bringing together proven solutions into a singular powerful technology platform designed to help protect and scale financial organizations. We guard our customers by being precise and reliable, we guide their success by combining powerful technology with proven expertise, and we help them grow by unleashing their potential.

  

**About the Team**

We are a small, high ownership AI team operating with the pace and ownership of a startup within a global enterprise. We build production grade AI products that are used by real customers, taking ideas from early experimentation and prototyping through evaluation, production deployment and continuous improvement. The team brings together AI product management, AI engineering and data expertise, with a strong emphasis on shipping, experimentation, quality and measurable customer outcomes. We work closely with product, engineering and domain teams across the business to identify where AI can create meaningful value and then build the systems required to deliver it reliably at scale. This is an opportunity to work on some of the core AI products shaping how modern AI is applied within enterprise software, while having significant influence over what we build, how we evaluate it and how AI products are built and operated in production.

  

**About the Position**

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager - AI to lead the development of production grade AI products that solve complex problems for enterprise customers.
  
  
This is a highly hands on product role for someone who understands that building AI products is fundamentally different from building traditional software. You will work at the intersection of product, data, AI, and domain expertise, with significant ownership over both the product outcome and the process used to prove that the AI system can reliably deliver it.
  
  
This is a builder role. You will not simply manage a backlog of AI features or translate requirements between customers and engineering. You will be expected to understand the problem, formulate the hypothesis, work with the data, determine how AI can solve it, establish how success will be measured, validate the solution and drive it all the way into production.
  
  
The goal is not to build AI for the sake of using AI. The goal is to build reliable, production-grade AI products that create measurable value for enterprise customers.

  

**Role and Responsibilities**

Identify high value customer problems, develop hypotheses around where AI can create measurable value and validate those hypotheses using data, experimentation and customer feedback.
  
  
Work hands on with large and complex datasets to understand the problem, identify patterns, test assumptions, and determine what is required to build an effective AI solution.
  
  
Partner with AI engineering and data teams to design AI powered product experiences, including grounding and retrieval systems, prompts, model selection, orchestration and AI workflows.
  
  
Build and own AI evaluation frameworks, including evaluation datasets, golden sets, test cases, metrics, automated evaluations, and human evaluation processes.
  
  
Establish AI monitoring and observability for production systems and use evaluation and production data to identify failures, understand root causes and continuously improve the product.
  
  
Drive AI capabilities from prototype and proof of concept through production deployment, customer adoption and continuous improvement.
  
  
Define and measure the product and AI metrics that demonstrate whether the system is delivering the intended customer outcome.

  

**About You**

What We Are Looking For: • 7+ years of product management experience, with significant experience building and shipping B2B software products. • Strong hands-on experience building AI-powered products, where AI is a core part of the product experience and customer outcome. • Deep practical understanding of AI evaluation and experience building evaluation frameworks for AI products. • Strong experience with AI monitoring and observability, including identifying, diagnosing, and addressing failures in production AI systems. • Strong data skills and experience working with large-scale data. You should be comfortable understanding data structures, exploring datasets, analyzing data, and using data to validate product hypotheses and AI behavior. • Experience designing and building grounding systems and evaluation systems, rather than simply consuming AI APIs. • Experience with modern AI application architectures, including LLMs, RAG, embeddings, prompting, model selection, agents/workflows, and orchestration. • Demonstrated ability to take an ambiguous problem, formulate hypotheses, validate them with data and experimentation, and turn the resulting insight into a production product. • Experience building products for B2B customers in heavily regulated industries, such as financial services, fintech, insurance, healthcare, or similar domains. • Strong understanding of enterprise AI considerations including accuracy, reliability, explainability, security, governance, data quality, and auditability. • Ability to work deeply with technical teams and engage in detailed discussions about AI system behavior without needing to be the engineer implementing the system. • Familiarity with the AWS ecosystem is preferred. • Strong product judgment and the ability to distinguish between an impressive AI demo and an AI system that is genuinely reliable enough for production use. What Will Set You Apart: • You have taken an AI product from hypothesis prototype evaluation production continuous monitoring and improvement. • You have personally designed or owned an AI evaluation framework and understand why evaluation is central to building reliable AI products. • You have worked through difficult AI failure modes and know how to investigate whether a problem originates in the model, data, retrieval, grounding, prompting, orchestration, or product workflow. • You have experience building AI products where incorrect outputs have meaningful business or customer consequences. • You are comfortable challenging an initial hypothesis when the data or evaluations do not support it. • You naturally think in terms of measurable customer outcomes rather than AI features. • You enjoy getting into the details and are equally comfortable discussing a customer workflow, analyzing an evaluation dataset, investigating AI output failures, and working with engineers on the product architecture.

  

**Preferred Experience Level**

7 years

  

**Preferred Education Level**

Master's Degree

  

**Employment Basis**

Full Time

  

**Benefits**

Group Medical Insurance, Group Personal Accident, Employee Anniversary gift, Loyalty Bonus, Employee Referral Bonus, Rewards and Recognition program, Wellness Allowance, Privilege Leave (PL): 15 days per year, Casual Leave (CL) 12 days per year, Maternity/paternity/Bereavement leave

  

**Applications Close Date**

07 Apr 2027

**Company Description**

At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.

  
  
**Job Description**

* Define product requirements, work with engineering teams, and deliver solutions that meet user needs. Scope includes driving transformational growth across our Sports Research and Consulting products and solutions, as well as our Video Games Tracking research.
* Requires at least ten years of specialized depth and breadth of expertise relating to **multi-country quantitative research,** including questionnaire and code frame design, research process automation using AI, advanced analytical modelling and visualization of complex analytical outcomes from these data types. Also requires a strong proven understanding of marketing science as it applies to brand equity, sales forecasting, use of imputation and synthetic data, and a rigorous grounding in research statistics.

The following will give a candidate a strong advantage in applying for this role:

* Client facing experience with blue chip brand marketing teams and the insights teams that support them.
* Practical experience of large scale agentic AI applications in quantitative multi-country tracking survey research.

* Interprets internal or external business issues and recommends best practices
* Solves complex problems; Takes a broad perspective to identify innovative solutions
* Works independently, with guidance in only the most complex situations
* May lead functional teams or projects

Recognized for deep expertise in a specific discipline or function, solving complex problems and guiding project teams or functional processes.

Qualifications

job_description:
**About this role:**

Wells Fargo is seeking a Lead Product Manager

**In this role, you will:**

* Lead complex initiatives including establishing marketing programs for new products or enhancements
* Conduct market research and market results-oriented analysis for major products and services
* Review and analyze complex major product lines and services
* Implement change delivery solutions for the portfolio's technology process work of low to moderate complexity
* Make decisions in complex and multi-faceted situations of global market dynamics, trends, and regulatory impact
* Oversee risk management to meet deliverables and drive new initiatives
* Collaborate and consult with managers, stakeholders, scrum masters, project managers, and delivery team to resolve issues and achieve project goals
* Lead projects, teams, or serve as a mentor to less experienced staff

**Required Qualifications:**

* **5+** years of Product Management, Product Ownership, Business Analysis, or equivalent experience.
* Lead one or more product teams in delivering business and customer value through execution of product initiatives aligned with established product strategies and roadmaps.
* Own and prioritize the product backlog, ensuring alignment with business priorities, customer needs, risk requirements, and regulatory commitments.
* Collaborate with L2/L3 Product Managers and stakeholders to translate strategic objectives into actionable epics, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Drive backlog refinement, sprint planning, release planning, product reviews, and demonstrations to ensure effective execution and delivery.
* Partner with technology, architecture, operations, and business teams to define solutions and ensure successful implementation of product enhancements and capabilities.
* Facilitate prioritization decisions across competing demands while balancing customer value, operational efficiency, technical dependencies, and regulatory requirements.
* Manage cross-functional dependencies, identify delivery risks, remove impediments, and drive timely resolution of issues impacting product delivery.
* Validate business requirements and acceptance criteria to ensure delivered solutions meet customer expectations, quality standards, and business objectives.
* Monitor product area performance, user adoption, operational outcomes, and stakeholder feedback to identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
* Support process automation, AI-enabled capabilities, and modernization initiatives that enhance customer experience and operational effectiveness.
* Collaborate with Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Control partners to ensure solutions adhere to enterprise policies, governance frameworks, and regulatory requirements.
* Communicate product priorities, delivery progress, risks, and outcomes to stakeholders and leadership teams.
* Drive a culture of collaboration, accountability, continuous learning, and Agile best practices across the product team.
* Provide guidance and mentorship to junior Product Owners and team members while promoting effective product management practices.

**Desired Qualifications:**

* CSPO/PSPO Certified
* Experience in Commercial Banking, Supply Chain Finance, Lending, Receivables Finance, Treasury Management, Payments, or related banking domains.
* Experience supporting platform modernization, workflow automation, and digital transformation initiatives.
* Knowledge of banking regulatory, risk, and control frameworks.
* Experience with SQL, Power BI, data analytics, and reporting tools.
* Familiarity with AI, Generative AI, intelligent automation, and data-driven product decision making.
* Strong understanding of Agile, Scrum, Kanban, and modern product operating models.

**Posting End Date:**

28 Oct 2026

* ***Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.***

**We Value Equal Opportunity**

Wells Fargo is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. They are accountable for execution of all applicable risk programs (Credit, Market, Financial Crimes, Operational, Regulatory Compliance), which includes effectively following and adhering to applicable Wells Fargo policies and procedures, appropriately fulfilling risk and compliance obligations, timely and effective escalation and remediation of issues, and making sound risk decisions. There is emphasis on proactive monitoring, governance, risk identification and escalation, as well as making sound risk decisions commensurate with the business unit’s risk appetite and all risk and compliance program requirements.

Candidates applying to job openings posted in Canada: Applications for employment are encouraged from all qualified candidates, including women, persons with disabilities, aboriginal peoples and visible minorities. Accommodation for applicants with disabilities is available upon request in connection with the recruitment process.

**Applicants with Disabilities**

To request a medical accommodation during the application or interview process, visit Disability Inclusion at Wells Fargo.

**Drug and Alcohol Policy**

Wells Fargo maintains a drug free workplace. Please see our Drug and Alcohol Policy to learn more.

**Wells Fargo Recruitment and Hiring Requirements:**

a. Third-Party recordings are prohibited unless authorized by Wells Fargo.

b. Wells Fargo requires you to directly represent your own experiences during the recruiting and hiring process.

job_description:
Candidates for this position are preferred to be based in Bangalore, India and will be expected to comply with their team’s hybrid work schedule requirements.
  
  
Senior Manager, Product Management
  
  
**Team:** Customer Technology
  
**Location:** Bengaluru, India (Hybrid)
  
  
Who We Are
  
  
At Wayfair, we're working to make shopping more personal, relevant, and easier for millions of customers.
  
  
The Customer Understanding team builds the intelligence that helps Wayfair better understand what customers like, what they're looking for, and how their needs change over time. We turn customer behavior and signals into shared capabilities that power better search, recommendations, personalization, and shopping experiences.
  
  
This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of Product, AI/ML, and customer experience, solving problems at scale and shaping how Wayfair understands and serves its customers.
  
  
Learn more about our technology teams on the[1] Wayfair Tech Blog.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
**Think big and work backwards from the customer:** Imagine what a great shopping experience could look like, identify gaps in how we understand customers, and define what we need to build.
  
  
**Shape strategy, not just a roadmap:** Challenge assumptions, solve ambiguous problems, and build a clear point of view on where to invest and why.
  
  
**Work at the cutting edge of AI/ML and data:** Partner with ML, Data Science, Data Engineering, and Platform teams to build scalable products, balancing model quality, performance, reliability, and cost.
  
  
**Connect technology to customer impact:** Work with Search, Recommendations, and other teams to turn customer intelligence into better shopping experiences, and validate the impact with experiments.
  
  
**See the bigger picture:** Connect opportunities across teams, customer journeys, and businesses. Bring fresh thinking from industry trends and advances in AI.
  
  
**Navigate complexity and drive progress:** Work across distributed teams with different priorities, build alignment, make trade-offs, and move things forward without waiting for perfect clarity.
  
  
**Own outcomes, not just delivery:** Take products from discovery to launch and adoption, measure real impact, and adapt based on what you learn.
  
  
What We're Looking For
  
  
9+ years of product management experience, with a track record of owning complex products and delivering measurable customer or business impact.
  
  
Strong product thinking, with the ability to break down ambiguous problems, identify opportunities, and build a clear strategy.
  
  
Experience working with Engineering, Data Science, or ML teams on data-driven, platform, or algorithmic products.
  
  
Strong analytical skills and experience using customer insights, data, and experimentation to guide decisions.
  
  
Ability to understand technical concepts and trade-offs, while staying focused on customer problems and business outcomes.
  
  
Strong communication and collaboration skills, especially when working across multiple teams and stakeholders.
  
  
It's a Plus If You Have
  
  
Experience in e-commerce, personalization, search, recommendations, or customer data products.
  
  
Familiarity with customer embeddings, intent modeling, recommender systems, or cold-start personalization.
  
  
Experience building ML-powered products or reusable data and intelligence platforms.

text:
Candidates for this position are preferred to be based in Bangalore, India and will be expected to comply with their team’s hybrid work schedule requirements.
  
  
Senior Manager, Product Management
  
  
**Team:** Customer Technology
  
**Location:** Bengaluru, India (Hybrid)
  
  
Who We Are
  
  
At Wayfair, we're working to make shopping more personal, relevant, and easier for millions of customers.
  
  
The Customer Understanding team builds the intelligence that helps Wayfair better understand what customers like, what they're looking for, and how their needs change over time. We turn customer behavior and signals into shared capabilities that power better search, recommendations, personalization, and shopping experiences.
  
  
This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of Product, AI/ML, and customer experience, solving problems at scale and shaping how Wayfair understands and serves its customers.
  
  
Learn more about our technology teams on the[1] Wayfair Tech Blog.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
**Think big and work backwards from the customer:** Imagine what a great shopping experience could look like, identify gaps in how we understand customers, and define what we need to build.
  
  
**Shape strategy, not just a roadmap:** Challenge assumptions, solve ambiguous problems, and build a clear point of view on where to invest and why.
  
  
**Work at the cutting edge of AI/ML and data:** Partner with ML, Data Science, Data Engineering, and Platform teams to build scalable products, balancing model quality, performance, reliability, and cost.
  
  
**Connect technology to customer impact:** Work with Search, Recommendations, and other teams to turn customer intelligence into better shopping experiences, and validate the impact with experiments.
  
  
**See the bigger picture:** Connect opportunities across teams, customer journeys, and businesses. Bring fresh thinking from industry trends and advances in AI.
  
  
**Navigate complexity and drive progress:** Work across distributed teams with different priorities, build alignment, make trade-offs, and move things forward without waiting for perfect clarity.
  
  
**Own outcomes, not just delivery:** Take products from discovery to launch and adoption, measure real impact, and adapt based on what you learn.
  
  
What We're Looking For
  
  
9+ years of product management experience, with a track record of owning complex products and delivering measurable customer or business impact.
  
  
Strong product thinking, with the ability to break down ambiguous problems, identify opportunities, and build a clear strategy.
  
  
Experience working with Engineering, Data Science, or ML teams on data-driven, platform, or algorithmic products.
  
  
Strong analytical skills and experience using customer insights, data, and experimentation to guide decisions.
  
  
Ability to understand technical concepts and trade-offs, while staying focused on customer problems and business outcomes.
  
  
Strong communication and collaboration skills, especially when working across multiple teams and stakeholders.
  
  
It's a Plus If You Have
  
  
Experience in e-commerce, personalization, search, recommendations, or customer data products.
  
  
Familiarity with customer embeddings, intent modeling, recommender systems, or cold-start personalization.
  
  
Experience building ML-powered products or reusable data and intelligence platforms.

job_description:
**Who We Are**
--------------

Welcome to TELUS Digital — where innovation drives impact at a global scale. As an award-winning digital product consultancy and the digital division of TELUS, one of Canada’s largest telecommunications providers, we design and deliver transformative customer experiences through cutting-edge technology, agile thinking, and a people-first culture.

With a global team across North America, South America, Central America, Europe, Africa, and APAC, we offer end-to-end expertise across various service offerings: Web, Mobile & Digital Marketing | Enterprise AI | Customer Care AI & Technology | Enterprise Technology Modernization

From mobile apps and websites to voice UI, chatbots, AI, customer service, and in-store solutions, TELUS Digital enables seamless, trusted, and digitally powered experiences that meet customers wherever they are — all backed by the secure infrastructure and scale of our multi-billion-dollar parent company.

**Location & Flexibility**
--------------------------

**India Hybrid: Bengaluru**
---------------------------

This is a hybrid role. This model requires the ability to work in a hybrid mode from our office in Bengaluru(2 to 3 times/ week). Our office culture is designed to foster in-person innovation, collaboration, and connection with team members, local and visiting, from other global offices.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

Robotics foundation models need millions of hours of dense, real-world data—and simulation alone won't cut it. TELUS Digital is solving the Physical AI bottleneck, capturing highly calibrated, real-world data at scale across hundreds of devices to power the world's leading hyperscalers.

We are hiring a **Group Product Manager** for the **Physical AI Robotics product team**. You will own the tooling this runs on: capture applications, operator workflows, session management, review and QA, and customer delivery. You will work with the researchers consuming the data and the operators producing it, and the standards you set will carry into how the industry does this.

Your application will stand out if you are demonstrably curious and have side work projects to showcase.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* 8-12 years in product management, including at least 2 in robotics, physical AI, AR/VR, autonomous systems, or data collection at scale.
* Own the roadmap for robotics data collection, setting direction and driving execution across engineering, design, operations, quality, and solutions.
* Assess demand for new capture modalities, then define the collection model, hardware, and tooling.
* Work with engineering and design on the operator experience: onboarding, task guidance, in-session feedback, error states, review workflows. Operators work one-handed, in motion, wearing a headset, or against a clock.
* Build prototypes and write the specs. Requirements and user stories that hold up under engineering review.
* Translate customer model requirements into collection designs, and evolving research into quality standards for egocentric data: pose accuracy, sync tolerance, occlusion handling, annotation schema, acceptance criteria.
* Spend time with collectors, session leads, and reviewers. When data underperforms in training, trace it back to the capture design or the tooling that produced it.
* Represent the product directly to hyperscaler and robotics foundation model teams, and bring their constraints back into the roadmap.
* Optimize for yield per session, rejection rate, cost per usable hour, capture-to-delivery time, and operator retention.
* Champion pilots as the default way to test a change. Small cohort, clear hypothesis, fixed window. Scale what works and stop what does not.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Information Systems) or equivalent experience..
* Technical depth to hold a real conversation with a research team.
* Direct experience with one or more of: egocentric or wearable data capture, teleoperation systems, robot data pipelines, multi-sensor collection rigs or similar setups
* Experience defining product vision and roadmaps in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.

* Hands-on robotics background. Robotics, ML engineer on embodied models, teleoperation engineer, or similar.
* Familiarity with imitation learning, VLA models, or manipulation policy training, and the data those methods need.
* Experience managing distributed human operations, including crowd or contractor workforces.
* You have shipped something physical and understand calibration, sensor sync, and coordinate frames, and how they fail.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
------------------------------

*At TELUS Digital, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. All aspects of employment, including the decision to hire and promote, are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.*

We will only use the information you provide to process your application and to produce tracking statistics. Since we do not request personal data deemed sensitive, we ask you to abstain from sharing that information with us.

For more information on how we use your information, see our Privacy Policy.

job_description:
**Company Summary**
===================

First American (India) is a GCC (Global Capability Center) of the First American Financial Corporation (NYSE: FAF) family of companies. FAI is a proud member of the FORTUNE 500 companies and has been amongst the Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For® list for eight consecutive years. First American Financial Corporation provides comprehensive title insurance, closing/settlement, property data and technology solutions. First American (India) creates quality solutions for its customers by combining software, back office, and knowledge processing operations to fulfill First American's business requirements. Our priorities are our employees, customers, and shareholders - in that order. First American (India) has been ranked amongst India's Best Companies To Work For™ 2023: Listed amongst the Top 100 by Great Place To Work® India, FAI is also certified Best Workplaces for Women and Workplace with Inclusive Practices. Software Services helps build First American's product suite that encompasses the best in class Title Insurance, Settlement and Mortgage solutions platforms. Leverages technology product stack across Microsoft platform predominantly to develop, enhance and maintain the best in class applications. The R & D division delivers solutions for the title insurance industry leveraging the best of NLP, AI and ML.

**Job Summary**
===============

**Company Overview**

First American (India) is a fully owned subsidiary of the First American Financial Corporation (US) - a leading provider of title insurance, settlement services and risk solutions for real estate transactions since 1889. First American also provides title plant management, home warranty, and banking, trust & wealth management services. With locations in Bangalore, Hyderabad and Salem, FAI delivers software development, back-office and knowledge-processing operations to support First American’s global operations in US, UK, Australia & Canada. FAI has been recognized as one among India’s Top workplaces by Great Place to Work®. Job Description

**Summary:**

We are looking for a highly motivated individual for the role of Product Manager. In this role, you will be responsible for defining, building, and launching innovative solutions that meet the evolving needs of our customers. You will collaborate closely with stakeholders to execute product strategies, create detailed product roadmaps and manage the lifecycle of the product.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Assist in the development and execution of product strategies and roadmaps.
* Conduct market research and competitive analysis to identify customer needs and market trends.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams including engineering, design and marketing to ensure successful product launches.
* Gather and prioritize product and customer requirements.
* Create detailed user stories and product specifications to guide the development process.
* Assist in the creation of product documentation, including user stories, product specifications, and release notes.
* Monitor product performance and gather user feedback to inform future product improvements.
* Support the product lifecycle from ideation to launch and post-launch activities.

**Basic Qualification:**

* 5+ years of experience in product management, preferably in enterprise SaaS.
* Minimum of 15 years of formal education.
* Sound knowledge in SDLC, Agile/scrum methodologies.
* Sound knowledge of using AI tools to write Product Briefs and developing prototypes.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Strong outcome orientation, with experience defining success metrics and measuring product impact.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment

**Preferred Qualification:**

* MBA from a reputed institute.
* Experience of launching zero to one products.
* Knowledge of Escrow /Title Insurance/ Mortgage industry, its processes and challenges.

  
FAI is committed to create an environment that respects, supports and inspires all individuals. We do not discriminate on the basis of color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation and age. At FAI, we celebrate diversity and believe that an inclusive workforce benefits employees, the organization and our community. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. For more information about our company and dedication to putting People First, check out https://firstam.wd1.myworkdayjobs.com/faicareers.

job_description:
**About MoEngage:**

MoEngage is an insights-led customer engagement platform trusted by 1,350+ global consumer brands, including McAfee, Flipkart, Domino’s, Nestle, Deutsche Telekom, and OYO. MoEngage combines data from multiple sources to help brands gain a 360-degree view of their customers.

MoEngage Analytics arms marketers and product owners with insights into customer behavior. Brands can leverage MoEngage Personalize to orchestrate journeys and build 1:1 conversations across the website, mobile, email, social, and messaging channels. MoEngage Inform, the transactional messaging infrastructure, helps unify promotional and transactional communication to a single platform for better insights and lower costs. MoEngage’s AI Suite helps marketers develop winning copies and creatives, optimize campaigns and channels that boost engagement, and help with faster execution.

For over a decade, consumer brands in 60+ countries have been using MoEngage to power digital experiences for over a billion monthly customers. With offices in 15 countries, MoEngage is backed by Goldman Sachs Asset Management, B Capital, Steadview Capital, Multiples Private Equity, Eight Roads, F-Prime Capital, Matrix Partners, Ventureast, and Helion Ventures.

MoEngage was named a Contender in The Forrester Wave™: Real-Time Interaction Management, Q1 2024 report, and Strong Performer in The Forrester Wave™ 2023 report. MoEngage was also featured as a Leader in the IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Omni-Channel Marketing Platforms for B2C Enterprises 2023.

**About the Role**  
Messaging is where marketing actually meets the customer — the push that gets opened, the WhatsApp that gets replied to, the SMS that drives the click. You'll own a slice of the Campaigns product — the engine behind messaging across Push, Email, SMS, WhatsApp, RCS, and In-App channels — and be judged on whether customers actually adopt what you ship, not on how well you followed the spec someone else wrote.  
You're a few years into your PM career, not new to it. You've shipped things end-to-end, learned what "done" actually means in practice, and know the difference between a feature customers use every day and a feature that only exists in a release note.  
You'll report into the Campaigns product team, work shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering and design, and spend a meaningful chunk of your week talking to customers, reading support threads, and digging through usage data — because that's where the real opportunities live, not in a brainstorm.

**Roles & Responsibilities**

* **Customer Research, Relentlessly-** Run structured VoC/VoP analysis — customer calls, support ticket audits, CSM conversations, in-app feedback — to build a constantly-updated picture of where Campaigns is winning and where it's losing deals or trust. Turn scattered anecdotes into a ranked list of real problems.
* **Opportunity Mining-** Don't wait for a PRD to land in your inbox. Mine support channels, churn signals, and feature requests to surface the 2-3 gaps that matter most this quarter — and defend why those and not the other twenty.
* **Execution, End to End-** From decision-anchored PRD to shipped feature — write the spec, resolve edge cases, sit in every standup that matters, unblock engineering, and make trade-off calls when scope and timeline collide. Ideas are cheap; shipped is the job.
* **Adoption Is the Metric-** Shipping isn't done at code-complete. Partner with CS, Sales, and Marketing to drive activation — enablement decks, in-app nudges, customer outreach — and own the adoption number, not just the release note.
* **Voice of the Customer, Internally-** Be the translator between "what customers are saying" and "what we build next." Feed structured research back into prioritization debates and hold the team accountable to solving the problem, not just the ticket.

**What we're looking for**

* 3+ years of product management experience in a B2B SaaS environment.
* Evidence you've owned something end-to-end — from problem discovery to shipped, adopted feature — not just been on the team that did.
* Sharp customer instincts, and the willingness to keep earning them by talking to actual users every single week.
* A clear thinker and clearer writer; you can turn a messy problem into a one-pager that gets a decision made.

**Bonus points**

* Experience in Martech / Customer Engagement / Marketing Automation.
* Familiarity with messaging channels (SMS, WhatsApp, RCS, Push) as a builder or a heavy operator.
* Comfort with API-driven or platform products, and the ambiguity that comes with them.

At MoEngage, we respect and value differences. We believe that when people from diverse backgrounds and perspectives collaborate, we create the most value – for our clients, our employees, and society. We embrace diversity and uphold a strong set of values. We are committed to inclusivity and take pride in providing equal opportunities for success and growth.

Employment at MoEngage is based solely on professional competence, skills, and experience. We stand firmly against all forms of discrimination and support equal rights and opportunities regardless of gender, ethnicity, abilities, age, identity, orientation or expression, marital status (including pregnancy), religion and beliefs, or any other status protected by law.

It is our policy to comply with all applicable national, state, and local laws related to non-discrimination and equal opportunity. MoEngage is truly a place where everyone can bring their passions, authentic selves, and talents to work, collaborating to drive progress and solve meaningful challenges.

  

**Why Join Us!**

At MoEngage, we are passionate about our team and technology - see below to know more about us.

Life@MoEngage

Tech@MoEngage

Scale @MoEngage

We handle more than a billion messages every day. Rest assured, you will be surrounded by really smart and passionate people as we scale much more to build a world-class technology team.
