to end Product management life cycle starting from roadmap to marketing activities.

* Oversee strategic program roadmap, development, launch, and marketing to gain maximum

benefit from each product

* Oversee day-to-day product management for core products such as product delivery, client

experience, and client communication strategies as well as help the team prioritize, negotiate,

and remove obstacles to achieve business results

* Create low-fidelity wireframes, prototypes, documentation to make your case stronger
* Execute client value propositions, positioning, segmentation, pricing, targeting, channel

strategies, and competitive differentiation to achieve preferred status as a partner to VCPL

Clients

* Develop plans and execute functional strategies for a country, multiple countries, region, or

business requiring coordination and integration across units as well as provide input into

strategic decisions affecting job family or function within a region or business

* Manage client and competitor market research, contribute in production innovation roadmap,

continuously improving and modernizing the presentation of the products in the market,

create relevant documentation managing the product life cycle.

* Contribute to achievement of acquisition targets, product financial performance, revenue

performance, and expense management goals.

* Develop and communicate a business plan to approach the marketplace, and coordinate and

implement team procedures, client problem resolutions and client management.

* Reports project status, scope changes and critical metrics to all stakeholders including core

team and senior management

* Serve as a liaison with other teams to ensure timely completion of project tasks.
* Define milestones with Product Owner and Scrum Master and coordinate with various internal

and external stakeholders to launch products as per defined timelines.

* Preempt potential delays, and de-bottleneck issues quickly in order to avoid slippage
* Run tight project management to meet launch timelines.

Qualifications:

* MBA and engineering degree preferred
* Sound experience in market research and product management life cycle along with detail to

the documentation.

* Familiar with Agile methodologies
* Functional experience in marketing, credit, acquisitions, product development, or analytics
* Ability to work under pressure and manage deadlines or unexpected changes in expectations

or requirements

* Ability to work unsupervised and adjust priorities quickly as circumstances dictate
* Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication
* Demonstrated analytical skills
* Demonstrated problem-solving and decision-making skills
* Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication

title: Senior Product Manager - APAC
job_description:
Date live: 10/22/2026

Business Area: Investing and Lending

Area of Expertise: Investment Banking

Contract: Permanent

Reference Code: JR-0000131619

  

Join us as Senior Product Manager - APAC, where you will be responsible for the development and oversight of our loan and overdraft products across India, broader Asia and the Middle East. You will work closely with loan originators and broader stakeholders across the region, including coordinating new product approvals, performing annual product reviews, and acting as the business product owner in the region to help prioritise technology and process changes. You will also work closely with Operations and Technology on the rollout of our strategic loan platform across the region. The role will sit with our Investment Banking Origination team in Mumbai and report jointly to the Global Head of Loan Product Management and the Global Head of Loan Transformation.

  
  

To be successful in this role, you should:

Be a strong and ambitious candidate at Vice President level with strong product management, business analysis, stakeholder management and loan product knowledge, along with the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

  
  

Essential Skills/Basic Qualifications:

* Strong business analysis skills, including the ability to capture key requirements.
* Strong bilateral and syndicated loan product knowledge.
* Strong communication, relationship management and networking skills.
* Strong product management skills.
* Ability to capture key requirements and summarise them into management-style presentations and proposals.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
* Ability to challenge existing ways of working and drive process improvements.
  

  

Desirable Skills/Preferred Qualifications:

* Good presentation and PowerPoint skills.
* Understanding of process design, optimisation and ownership, with a focus on client outcomes and operational effectiveness.
* Exposure to product ownership models within complex, multi-stakeholder organisations.
* Understanding of regulatory requirements and controls within lending processes.
* Experience working in agile or hybrid delivery environments.
  

  

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as:

* Contributing to and influencing policies and procedures for the function, and planning, managing and consulting on multiple complex and critical strategic projects which may be business-wide.
* Providing expert advice to business and functional management and committees to influence decisions.
* Escalating breaches of policies and procedures appropriately.
* Fostering and guiding compliance, ensuring regulations are observed and relevant processes are in place to facilitate adherence.
* Focusing on the external environment, regulators or advocacy groups to both monitor and influence on behalf of Barclays, when appropriate.
* Maintaining broad and comprehensive knowledge of industry theories and practices within the relevant discipline, alongside up-to-date sector and functional knowledge and insight into external market developments and initiatives.
* Negotiating with and influencing stakeholders at a senior level, both internally and externally.
* Acting as a principal contact point for key clients and counterparts in other functions and business divisions.
* Acting as a mandated spokesperson for the function and business division.
  

  

Job location is Mumbai.

**Purpose of the role**

To develop and manage the wholesale lending products and services, collaborating with, and ensuring service standards are complied with by, business partners across the bank, including investment bankers, credit analysts, risk managers, and operations professionals, to ensure that our products meet the needs of the bank's clients and are aligned with the bank's overall strategic objectives whilst ensuring all governance, control, regulatory and legal requirements are met.

**Accountabilities**

* Development and execution of product strategy for financial products and services offered within the wholesale division. .
* Identification of investments opportunities and customer needs to create new products or enhance existing ones. .
* Management of the entire product lifecycle, including product planning, development, launch, and ongoing management, including oversight of service levels. .
* Analysis of market data to make informed decisions regarding product positioning and pricing. .
* Assessment and management of risks associated with lending products and implement risk mitigation strategies, including the operation of and attendance to governance forums. .
* Oversight of regulatory and technological change.

**Vice President Expectations**

* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Platform Product Manager
job_description:
**About us**

Hyperproof is on a mission to transform the Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) world with a powerful new software platform. With Hyperproof, companies can save time and money while also operating their programs at a much higher level of effectiveness and accountability. We envision a world where organizations we depend on are truly trustworthy - and Hyperproof is the platform that will get them there.

We have a great team and culture - picture yourself in a highly collaborative startup environment where you can make a real impact on something truly important. It's an exciting time to be at Hyperproof; we raised our Series B round in 2023, validating our teamwork and company vision, and we continue to grow rapidly.

We are seeking a visionary and hands-on Principal Platform Product Manager to serve as a product leader and GRC domain strategy owner across our platform. In this high-impact individual contributor role, you will define and execute our holistic AI product strategy, driving the next generation of agentic systems, trustworthy automation, and eval-driven GRC workflows. You will focus on high-impact problem selection, grounding, and auditability to ensure our intelligent features deliver provable value and measurable time-bound outcomes within rigorous compliance guardrails.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**

* **AI Product Vision & Strategy:** Own the end-to-end strategy, architecture, roadmap, and execution for Hyperproof's platform AI capabilities, intelligent agents, and automated workflows covering the full spectrum of the platform capabilities.
* **Eval-Driven & Strategic Product Leadership:** Partner directly with engineering and GRC subject matter experts to author detailed product requirements, establish trust and grounding frameworks, define rigorous eval-driven development benchmarks, and maintain strict auditability and AI safety guardrails.
* **Agentic Workflows & Automation:** Lead the innovation of customer-facing AI agents and backend service integrations that automate complex, everyday GRC tasks for enterprise customers.
* **Cross-Functional Architecture Alignment:** Collaborate with executive stakeholders, engineering, design, and GRC domain experts to define constraint spaces, evaluation frameworks, and model integration standards across the platform. Ensure continuous partnership and alignment with go-to-market teams and establish strong customer relationships that drive product innovation aligned with the most important customer use cases.
* **Data-Driven & Experimental Validation:** Build rapid functional prototypes, analyze product usage metrics, establish rigorous eval benchmarks, and leverage customer feedback to continuously validate and improve AI features in production.
* **Thought Leadership & Market Advisory:** Serve as Hyperproof's subject matter expert on AI in governance, risk, and compliance at industry events, executive briefings, and customer advisory sessions.

**HOW YOU'LL KNOW YOU ARE SUCCESSFUL**

* Hundreds of enterprise companies, including well-known Fortune 500 customers, rely daily on your AI agents and workflows to automate compliance with provable, verifiable outcomes.
* Customers post rave reviews highlighting the speed, accuracy, and reliability of Hyperproof's AI features.
* You set the technical and strategic bar for AI product development across the company, elevating the capabilities of cross-functional team members.
* You successfully translate emerging AI/LLM technology advancements into defensible, high-value product opportunities that differentiate Hyperproof in the market.
* You drive measurable, time-bound business outcomes that increase platform efficiency and reduce manual compliance effort for enterprise customer teams.

**WHAT YOU WILL BRING**

* 8+ years of product management experience scaling enterprise SaaS platforms, with 2+ years of direct experience shipping production-grade AI/LLM products, agentic systems.
* Strong product leadership in AI application, with preferably deep understanding of GRC problem ownership, grounding, trust frameworks, auditability requirements, and eval-driven product development methodologies.
* Ability to act as a principal advisor, using professional concepts to resolve critical organizational issues and broad design challenges across engineering and product teams.
* Exceptional communication skills with a proven track record of bridging technical depth (engineering specs, model evals) with executive strategy and enterprise customer alignment.
* Demonstrated experience establishing AI safety, governance, verifiable results, and precision guardrails in production software.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).

**WHAT WILL BE A PLUS**

* Hands-on technical background in software engineering, spec-driven development, or data science.
* Domain experience in Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC), cybersecurity, or highly regulated enterprise environments.
* Hands-on familiarity with agent measurement tools, Claude Code, or developer-centric AI tooling.

**LOCATION**

* We are a fully remote company! Rather than restrict ourselves to only finding talent in one city, we'd rather find the absolute best people regardless of where they live.

**CANDIDATE EXPERIENCE**

* We value your time and want you to know what to expect from us. For this interview, we expect to ask you to participate in {Interview outline of meetings} and expect this to be completed in {hours}.
* 1st Interview Talent Acquisition
* 2nd Interview Hiring Manager
* 3rd Interview
* 4th Interview
* 5th Interview
* Total Time: 3.5 Hours

**WHERE YOU'LL GO**

* Hyperproof also loves to see an internal transfer. If a linear career path is not what you're looking for, you can work with your manager and our people team to explore lateral moves to other parts of the organization as you continue to grow with us.

**WHAT WE OFFER TO OUR EMPLOYEES**

**Please note: Benefits listed below are for employees in the United States; contractor roles or international positions may differ**

* Annual compensation reviews + equity
* Unlimited PTO: strongly encouraged to unplug and recharge
* Health: coverage for medical, dental, and vision - employee and dependents
* 401K, which vests immediately, complete with a 4% company match
* 12 weeks of Parental leave and 1 year free diapers and wipes with Honest
* Annual company in-person events and quarterly in-person connects
* $500 home office stipend - at the time of hire. Any additional home office needs are requested as needed.
* $100 quarterly paid wellness stipend
* Pet insurance discount
* Slack channel notifications turn off after 5 pm based on your time zone
* Two Hypercharge weeks of rest where we close company-wide (July & Dec)

It's an exciting time to be at Hyperproof — we recently raised $40 million in our Series B financing, further cementing Hyperproof as the emerging leader in the risk and compliance management space.

At Hyperproof's core are our passionate team members who focus on user experience, beautiful design, and evangelize a positive social impact of our cloud based platform. We help organizations streamline their risk and compliance workflows so our customers can spend more time strategically managing programs and less time wrangling spreadsheets.

We are disrupting the governance, risk, and compliance software space with our innovative platform by helping traditionally unsung heroes (compliance professionals) **do the right things so the wrong things don't happen.**

Learn more about the @hyperproof culture and how it all started.

**A NOTE ABOUT OUR INTERVIEW PROCESS**

We're committed to creating a fair, respectful, and secure hiring experience for everyone. As part of that commitment, we use standard verification steps throughout our interview process.

Here's what that means for you:

* We may conduct routine verification checks during the hiring process.
* You might be asked additional questions to better understand your experience and background.
* For video interviews, we ask that candidates be on camera without filters or visual modifications.

These steps are applied consistently for all candidates and are designed to ensure an equitable experience for everyone.

**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER**

Hyperproof is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace — it's one of our core values! Hyperproof is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

Our company is dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role, but your experience doesn't perfectly fit every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this role or others.

To ensure a smooth interview process, all candidates will be required to provide a valid phone number that is *not* a VOIP (Voice Over Internet Protocol) number. This helps us maintain clear and reliable communication throughout your interview experience.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Associate Product Manager
job_description:
FactSet creates flexible, open data and software solutions for over 200,000 investment professionals worldwide, providing instant access to financial data and analytics that investors use to make crucial decisions.

At FactSet, our values are the foundation of everything we do. They express how we act and operate , serve as a compass in our decision-making, and play a big role in how we treat each other, our clients, and our communities. We believe that the best ideas can come from anyone, anywhere, at any time, and that curiosity is the key to anticipating our clients’ needs and exceeding their expectations.

**Team's Impact**

The Analytics API & MCP Platform team is responsible for delivering FactSet's analytics capabilities through scalable APIs, developer platforms, and AI-enabled solutions. The team enables clients, partners, and internal applications to access portfolio analytics, performance attribution, risk, and investment insights through modern integration channels including APIs, Power BI, Snowflake, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) applications.

Our mission is to create seamless, secure, and scalable experiences that help clients integrate FactSet analytics into their workflows, applications, and AI-powered solutions.

**Role Overview**

The Associate Product Manager partners with clients, engineering teams, and business stakeholders to identify opportunities, solve customer problems, and deliver impactful product outcomes. This role supports the full product lifecycle, including discovery, requirements definition, execution, launch, adoption, and ongoing product optimization.

The ideal candidate combines strong analytical and technical skills with a product mindset and is passionate about APIs, developer experiences, data integration platforms, and AI-enabled workflows.

**What You'll Do**

**Customer & Product Discovery**

* Gather and analyse feedback from clients, prospects, and internal stakeholders to understand workflows, pain points, and product opportunities.

* Participate in product discovery activities, market research, and validation of new product concepts.

* Help define success metrics and measure product outcomes.

**Product Development & Execution**

* Define and document business requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.

* Collaborate closely with Engineering, UX, and stakeholders throughout the development lifecycle.

* Support prioritization of enhancements, client requests, defects, and technical improvements.

* Participate in testing, release validation, and post-release monitoring to ensure product quality.

**Analytics API & MCP Platform Ownership**

* Develop deep expertise in Analytics APIs, MCP solutions, developer workflows, and platform capabilities.

* Support client onboarding, implementation, and adoption of Analytics API and MCP solutions.

* Troubleshoot product, integration, entitlement, authentication, and configuration issues.

* Act as a subject matter expert for internal stakeholders and client-facing teams.

**Adoption, Monitoring & Enablement**

* Monitor usage, client adoption, and key product health metrics.

* Help improve product instrumentation, analytics, and reporting capabilities.

* Create and maintain product documentation, knowledge base content, release communications, and onboarding materials.

* Support internal training and client enablement initiatives.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with Product, Engineering, Consulting, Sales, Support, and Client Success teams to deliver successful outcomes.

* Contribute ideas that improve processes, product quality, scalability, and client experience.

Demonstrate ownership, accountability, and a continuous learning mindset.  



**What We're Looking For**

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field.

* 2-5 years of experience in Product Development, Product Management, Business Analysis, Financial Technology, or a related role.

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

* Ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

* Experience working in Agile software development environments.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* MBA and working knowledge on Python preffered

* Understanding of REST APIs, API lifecycle management, authentication, and developer workflows.

* Experience with API testing and troubleshooting tools (e.g., Postman).

* Familiarity with JSON, OpenAPI specifications, and technical documentation.

* Experience supporting integrations with **Power BI** , **Snowflake** , or similar analytics and data platforms.

* Exposure to AI, LLMs, MCP, copilots, or agent-based applications.

Knowledge of portfolio analytics, performance attribution, risk analytics, or investment workflows.  



**Key Competencies**

**Insights**

* Uses data, client feedback, and market research to identify product opportunities and drive decisions.

**Strategy**

* Understands how Analytics APIs, Snowflake, Power BI, and MCP capabilities support FactSet's broader platform strategy.

**Execution**

* Delivers high-quality product outcomes through strong requirements, prioritization, testing, and stakeholder collaboration.

**Technical Expertise**

* Develops expertise in APIs, data integration platforms, developer tooling, and AI-enabled workflows.

**Leadership & Collaboration**

* Influences through communication, data, and relationship building while effectively collaborating across cross-functional teams.

**Career Progression**

**Product Specialist Senior Product Specialist Associate Product Manager Product Manager Senior Product Manager**

  

**What's In It For You**

At FactSet, our people are our greatest asset, and our culture is our biggest competitive advantage. Being a FactSetter means:

* The opportunity to join an S&P 500 company with over 45 years of sustainable growth powered by the entrepreneurial spirit of a start-up.
* Support for your total well-being. This includes health, life, and disability insurance, as well as retirement savings plans and a discounted employee stock purchase program, plus paid time off for holidays, family leave, and company-wide wellness days.
* Flexible work accommodations. We value work/life harmony and offer our employees a range of accommodations to help them achieve success both at work and in their personal lives.
* A global community dedicated to volunteerism and sustainability, where collaboration is always encouraged, and individuality drives solutions.
* Career progression planning with dedicated time each month for learning and development.
* Business Resource Groups open to all employees that serve as a catalyst for connection, growth, and belonging.
  

Salary is just one component of our compensation package and is based on several factors including but not limited to education, work experience, and certifications.

**Company Overview:**

FactSet ( NYSE:FDS | NASDAQ:FDS ) helps the financial community to see more, think bigger, and work better. Our digital platform and enterprise solutions deliver financial data, analytics, and open technology to more than 8,200 global clients, including over 200,000 individual users. Clients across the buy-side and sell-side, as well as wealth managers, private equity firms, and corporations, achieve more every day with our comprehensive and connected content, flexible next-generation workflow solutions, and client-centric specialized support. As a member of the S&P 500, we are committed to sustainable growth and have been recognized among the Best Places to Work in 2023 by Glassdoor as a Glassdoor Employees’ Choice Award winner. Learn more at www.factset.com and follow us on X and LinkedIn .

At FactSet, we celebrate difference of thought, experience, and perspective. Qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to characteristics protected by law.
text:
FactSet creates flexible, open data and software solutions for over 200,000 investment professionals worldwide, providing instant access to financial data and analytics that investors use to make crucial decisions.

At FactSet, our values are the foundation of everything we do. They express how we act and operate , serve as a compass in our decision-making, and play a big role in how we treat each other, our clients, and our communities. We believe that the best ideas can come from anyone, anywhere, at any time, and that curiosity is the key to anticipating our clients’ needs and exceeding their expectations.

**Team's Impact**

The Analytics API & MCP Platform team is responsible for delivering FactSet's analytics capabilities through scalable APIs, developer platforms, and AI-enabled solutions. The team enables clients, partners, and internal applications to access portfolio analytics, performance attribution, risk, and investment insights through modern integration channels including APIs, Power BI, Snowflake, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) applications.

Our mission is to create seamless, secure, and scalable experiences that help clients integrate FactSet analytics into their workflows, applications, and AI-powered solutions.

**Role Overview**

The Associate Product Manager partners with clients, engineering teams, and business stakeholders to identify opportunities, solve customer problems, and deliver impactful product outcomes. This role supports the full product lifecycle, including discovery, requirements definition, execution, launch, adoption, and ongoing product optimization.

The ideal candidate combines strong analytical and technical skills with a product mindset and is passionate about APIs, developer experiences, data integration platforms, and AI-enabled workflows.

**What You'll Do**

**Customer & Product Discovery**

* Gather and analyse feedback from clients, prospects, and internal stakeholders to understand workflows, pain points, and product opportunities.

* Participate in product discovery activities, market research, and validation of new product concepts.

* Help define success metrics and measure product outcomes.

**Product Development & Execution**

* Define and document business requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.

* Collaborate closely with Engineering, UX, and stakeholders throughout the development lifecycle.

* Support prioritization of enhancements, client requests, defects, and technical improvements.

* Participate in testing, release validation, and post-release monitoring to ensure product quality.

**Analytics API & MCP Platform Ownership**

* Develop deep expertise in Analytics APIs, MCP solutions, developer workflows, and platform capabilities.

* Support client onboarding, implementation, and adoption of Analytics API and MCP solutions.

* Troubleshoot product, integration, entitlement, authentication, and configuration issues.

* Act as a subject matter expert for internal stakeholders and client-facing teams.

**Adoption, Monitoring & Enablement**

* Monitor usage, client adoption, and key product health metrics.

* Help improve product instrumentation, analytics, and reporting capabilities.

* Create and maintain product documentation, knowledge base content, release communications, and onboarding materials.

* Support internal training and client enablement initiatives.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with Product, Engineering, Consulting, Sales, Support, and Client Success teams to deliver successful outcomes.

* Contribute ideas that improve processes, product quality, scalability, and client experience.

Demonstrate ownership, accountability, and a continuous learning mindset.  



**What We're Looking For**

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field.

* 2-5 years of experience in Product Development, Product Management, Business Analysis, Financial Technology, or a related role.

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

* Ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

* Experience working in Agile software development environments.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* MBA and working knowledge on Python preffered

* Understanding of REST APIs, API lifecycle management, authentication, and developer workflows.

* Experience with API testing and troubleshooting tools (e.g., Postman).

* Familiarity with JSON, OpenAPI specifications, and technical documentation.

* Experience supporting integrations with **Power BI** , **Snowflake** , or similar analytics and data platforms.

* Exposure to AI, LLMs, MCP, copilots, or agent-based applications.

Knowledge of portfolio analytics, performance attribution, risk analytics, or investment workflows.  



**Key Competencies**

**Insights**

* Uses data, client feedback, and market research to identify product opportunities and drive decisions.

**Strategy**

* Understands how Analytics APIs, Snowflake, Power BI, and MCP capabilities support FactSet's broader platform strategy.

**Execution**

* Delivers high-quality product outcomes through strong requirements, prioritization, testing, and stakeholder collaboration.

**Technical Expertise**

* Develops expertise in APIs, data integration platforms, developer tooling, and AI-enabled workflows.

**Leadership & Collaboration**

* Influences through communication, data, and relationship building while effectively collaborating across cross-functional teams.

**Career Progression**

**Product Specialist Senior Product Specialist Associate Product Manager Product Manager Senior Product Manager**

  

**What's In It For You**

At FactSet, our people are our greatest asset, and our culture is our biggest competitive advantage. Being a FactSetter means:

* The opportunity to join an S&P 500 company with over 45 years of sustainable growth powered by the entrepreneurial spirit of a start-up.
* Support for your total well-being. This includes health, life, and disability insurance, as well as retirement savings plans and a discounted employee stock purchase program, plus paid time off for holidays, family leave, and company-wide wellness days.
* Flexible work accommodations. We value work/life harmony and offer our employees a range of accommodations to help them achieve success both at work and in their personal lives.
* A global community dedicated to volunteerism and sustainability, where collaboration is always encouraged, and individuality drives solutions.
* Career progression planning with dedicated time each month for learning and development.
* Business Resource Groups open to all employees that serve as a catalyst for connection, growth, and belonging.
  

Salary is just one component of our compensation package and is based on several factors including but not limited to education, work experience, and certifications.

**Company Overview:**

FactSet ( NYSE:FDS | NASDAQ:FDS ) helps the financial community to see more, think bigger, and work better. Our digital platform and enterprise solutions deliver financial data, analytics, and open technology to more than 8,200 global clients, including over 200,000 individual users. Clients across the buy-side and sell-side, as well as wealth managers, private equity firms, and corporations, achieve more every day with our comprehensive and connected content, flexible next-generation workflow solutions, and client-centric specialized support. As a member of the S&P 500, we are committed to sustainable growth and have been recognized among the Best Places to Work in 2023 by Glassdoor as a Glassdoor Employees’ Choice Award winner. Learn more at www.factset.com and follow us on X and LinkedIn .

At FactSet, we celebrate difference of thought, experience, and perspective. Qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to characteristics protected by law.

title: Senior Digital Product Manager
job_description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Product backlog and prioritization of user stories with team members
* Manage Capital fund and work directly with Finance to ensure we our budget is in line
* Establish success metrics, OKRs (Objective and Key Results), and go-to-market plan and help lead
* Product owners in meeting their Business Objectives
* Be the voice of the customer and end-user; proactively provide customer feedback to internal teams. This includes being the voice of the service organization that is closest to the customer.
* Practical understanding of Scrum principles and practices
* Partners with Scrum master's in supporting Scrum Framework
* Shares and decomposes Features into user stories (non-technical)
* Develop a deep understanding of the customer and product needs
* Recognized voice of the business to the team
* Test, validate and identify weaknesses in prototypes and make the necessary changes (A/B, research, analysis, usability, etc.)
* Build, manage and develop a team of business analysts/testers.
* Ensures traceability between requirements to Features to user stories
* Review of test cases against user stories acceptance criteria
* Periodically re-prioritize the Product Backlog based on customer feedback, market changes and business priority as communicated by the Product Manager
* Formally accepts the user stories once all acceptance criteria are met
* Actively participates in Product Backlog grooming sessions, retrospectives, defect management and project team's release planning sessions
* Accessible for the team to answer questions, and during Sprint planning sessions, and Daily Scrum
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements.

**What you will need to be successful:**

* **Vision**: Always looking through the lens of the consumer and thinking of how to make their life better
* A solid understanding of User Experience: Experience in product management, product development, and User Experience design
* **Ability to ask Why:** Comfortable asking the right questions to quickly understand the core of the user needs
* **Instinct**: Solid consumer product instincts
* **Dig Deep:** Being able to dig in and go all the way down the rabbit hole to identify those unique opportunities
* **Collaboration**: Experience incubating and commercializing new ideas by working closely with technical and creative teams. Ability to navigate and lead through a complex matrix organization to deliver outcomes
* **Communication**: Ability to present and hold a dialog in a variety of forums: executive, front-line and industry events
* Influence without authority: Provide guidance and information to business for prioritizing high value work

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or 5+ years of additional relevant experience
* 5+ years of experience with Product Owner, Project Management and / or Business Analysis
* 5+ years of experience working in a contact Center/Call Center Environment
* 3+ years working with Finance managing budgets and financial goals
* Experience driving teams and management to decisions
* Experience working with cross functional teams
* Experience systematically analyzing problems, drawing relevant conclusions, and devising appropriate courses of action

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience in working with Agile / Scrum work environment as a Product Owner: writing user stories, and following the development process through user story acceptance
* Experience working with IVR or call technology systems
* Healthcare insurance industry experience
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio and Outlook
* Demonstrated ability to effectively break down barriers to maintain progress on initiatives
* Demonstrated ability to make quick decisions when clarification or modification is needed
* Proven diplomatic with solid negotiation and conflict resolution skills
* Proven adept at adjusting to changing circumstances quickly and professionally
* Proven excellent oral, written and interpersonal communication with both technical and business audiences
* Demonstrated strategic thinking by using appropriate information to diagnose problems, identify possible solutions and collaborate with impacted groups to drive decisions
* Proven self-directed and able to drive detailed solutions to completion with minimal oversight
* Proven detail oriented and obsessively organized

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager- SCM/Ecommerce
job_description:
As a Product Manager at Oracle NetSuite, you will help shape and deliver supply chain, Mobile, and Warehouse Management solutions from discovery through release. You will work closely with engineering, design, quality assurance, support, and go-to-market teams to solve customer problems and deliver products on schedule and within budget.

You will define product strategy, requirements, and priorities using customer feedback, business needs, and product insights. A key part of the role is identifying where GenAI and intelligent automation can simplify workflows, reduce manual effort, and improve the user experience. You will translate these opportunities into clear requirements and measurable outcomes, considering accuracy, data privacy, and user control.

Your responsibilities will include aligning teams on product decisions, reviewing designs and documentation, managing dependencies, and supporting successful releases. You will also use AI tools to improve product discovery, requirements development, documentation, and test planning, while applying sound judgment to their outputs.

This role requires independent judgment, strong communication, and the ability to manage complex priorities. You may lead cross-functional initiatives and mentor junior colleagues. A bachelor’s or master’s degree in a relevant field, or equivalent practical experience, is required.

  

Responsbilities:

* Collaborate with Manufacturers and Wholesale Distributors to build the next generation of supply chain solution
* Proactively define and drive the creation of new features that customers love
* Identify opportunities to use GenAI and intelligent automation to simplify workflows, improve decisions, and reduce manual effort
* Create use cases, user stories, and detailed product requirements document that clearly articulate desired product functionality
* Collaborate with Development, QA, Doc, and UI to deliver great products and tools for both the customers as well as developers
* Build a strong understanding of the market, competitive landscape, and emerging AI capabilities relevant to supply chain operations
* Manage the product backlog and prioritize product enhancements, customer and partner requests by making smart, decisive tradeoffs using data-driven analysis and sound judgment
* Partner with Marketing, Sales, Professional Services and Support to successfully rollout our products and ensure a great end-to-end customer experience
Evaluate AI-enabled features for usefulness, accuracy, reliability, and appropriate user control  

Qualifications/Skills:

* Must be a self-motivated team player
* Ability to gather complex customer requirements and translate requirements into a detail plan for execution
* Strong functional knowledge in at least two areas: Inventory, Warehouse Management, Fulfillment, Shipping, or Outbound Order Processing
* Preferably 5+ years of product management experience, with experience delivering applications through at least two product releases
* Practical experience with GenAI or AI-related projects is a plus, particularly in enterprise applications, workflow automation, or decision support
* Ability to identify meaningful AI use cases and define how their value and quality will be measured.
B.Tech or Bachelor of Engineering required. MBA a plus  

Oracle NetSuite is investing in GenAI and AI-powered capabilities to improve supply chain execution, decision-making, and productivity. In this role, you will help shape intelligent workflows, predictive insights, automated configuration, and GenAI-enabled experiences across Mobile and WMS, making everyday work simpler and more effective for customers.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager - Marketing
job_description:
**About the role:**

  

* We’re looking for a highly organized, execution-focused Senior Product Manager to help accelerate innovation within Blackbaud Marketing, our AI-assisted digital marketing solution for nonprofit organizations.
* You thrive in turning ideas into outcomes, balancing customer needs with business priorities, and driving measurable results through disciplined product management.
* In this role, you’ll partner closely with engineering, design, customer success, and marketing teams to deliver AI-powered capabilities that help fundraisers engage supporters more effectively, scale digital campaigns, and maximize impact.
* This is an opportunity to shape the future of purpose-driven technology while helping social impact organizations achieve more with data, intelligence, and automation.

**What you'll do:**

  

* Drive rapid product delivery cycles, using AI-native product development practices to bring customer value to market in weeks rather than quarters.
* Translate customer, market, and fundraising insights into a prioritized product roadmap that delivers measurable business and customer outcomes.
* Lead multiple product initiatives from concept and experimentation through validation, launch, adoption, and continuous optimization.
* Define success metrics, monitor product performance, and use data-driven insights to inform decisions and improve customer experiences.
* Create clear product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria that enable engineering teams to deliver high-quality solutions efficiently.
* Manage and prioritize product backlogs to balance immediate customer needs with long-term innovation goals and platform growth.
* Collaborate across product, engineering, design, marketing, and customer success teams to ensure alignment, transparency, and successful execution.
* Champion AI-enabled ways of working that improve product development efficiency, customer outcomes, and innovation velocity.

**What you'll bring:**

  

* 5+ years of product management experience, ideally within SaaS, cloud-based platforms, or digital products.
* Knowledge of product lifecycle management and digital marketing technologies, including customer engagement, campaign management, analytics, and fundraising-focused solutions.
* Understanding of product discovery, experimentation, prioritization frameworks, and iterative development methodologies used to scale successful products.
* Experience defining product requirements, managing roadmaps and backlogs, and partnering with engineering teams to deliver customer-facing capabilities.
* Technical fluency with AI-powered solutions, data analytics, and modern product development tools used to drive decision-making and accelerate delivery.
* Proven success launching, optimizing, and scaling products while using performance metrics and customer insights to guide strategy and execution.
* Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders and communicating effectively with customers, senior leaders, and external partners.
* Passion for solving complex customer challenges and delivering intuitive, high-quality experiences that help organizations drive greater social impact.
* and able to work flexible hours as required by business priorities.

Stay up to date on everything Blackbaud, follow us on Linkedin, X, Instagram, Facebook and YouTube

Blackbaud powers social impact through purpose‑driven technology and responsible AI. Guided by our *Intelligence for Good®* vision, we’re building a culture where innovation, trust, and human expertise come together to help organizations make a greater difference in the world.

Blackbaud is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to maintaining an inclusive work environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, physical or mental disability, age, or veteran status or any other basis protected by federal, state, or local law.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Digital Product Manager -VP
job_description:
Date live: 10/21/2026

Business Area: Digital & Innovation

Area of Expertise: Product Development & Management

Contract: Permanent

Reference Code: JR-0000108227

  

Join us as a Senior Digital Product Owner - Digital Help & AI at Barclays where you'll be responsible for owning and enhancing the Digital Help experience across the mobile banking app and digital channels, with a focus on self-service tools and customer support journeys. You'll work closely with Product Owners and Product Managers to deliver activities that improve how customers access help and support digitally. This role will support the launch and evolution of integrated AI capabilities, including new features within the app and AI-assisted experiences. You'll take ownership of the customer journey, ensuring digital help solutions are intuitive, effective, and aligned to customer needs.

To be successful as a Senior Digital Product Owner - Digital Help & AI, you must have the following essential skills:

* Product ownership: Experience identifying customer needs through data and research, prioritising problems to solve based on business and customer value, and owning products from discovery through to post-launch optimisation.
* Delivery expertise: Proven ability to manage priorities, dependencies, risks, and milestones across both live customer journeys and new features.
* Data literacy: Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn complex data into clear and concise insights or business cases.
* Risk and controls: Understanding of risk and control frameworks, with the ability to ensure effective risk management and mitigation throughout product delivery.
* Stakeholder management: Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams - including engineers, designers, intelligence teams, and control functions - and stakeholders across the UK and India.
* Financial services experience: Experience working within the financial services industry, with an understanding of the UK regulatory, risk, and customer environment.

Some other highly valued skills may include:

* AI Knowledge: Understanding of Generative AI and Agentic AI products, including awareness of the governance, risk, and control frameworks required to deliver these solutions safely and responsibly

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

This role is based in Pune, India.

**Purpose of the role**

To manage and drive the innovation strategy to meet customer needs and ensure the bank's long-term success and competitive edge.

**Accountabilities**

* Execution of market research to understand customer needs, pain points, and emerging trends to support the analysis of profitability, market size and positioning for new products compared to existing offerings, and to identify opportunities for diversification to gain a competitive advantage.
* Collaboration with stakeholders across departments and teams including marketing, sales, technology, engineers, designers etc to generate innovative and feasible product ideas and prototypes for testing aligned with customer needs and strategic goals.
* Development of concepts and specifications which define features, functionalities, target market, user interface, technical specifications and potential revenue models of new products.
* Evaluation of the technical feasibility, legal compliance, and potential risks associated with the development and launch of the new product.
* Monitoring of market trends and analysis feedback from internal employees and target customers through prototypes, user testing sessions, and beta programs to identify areas for improvement to refine the product before launch.
* Management of comprehensive launch plans and technical deployments for products that establish rollout timelines, marketing strategies, training initiatives and communication channels to promote the launch new products effectively.
* Monitoring of key metrics such as adoption rates, usage patterns, customer satisfaction, and revenue generation to assess the product's performance against set goals.

**Vice President Expectations**

* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..

title: Senior Product Manager – DNA
job_description:
**Job Description**

It’s not just about your career or job title… It’s about who you are and the impact you will make on the world. Because whether it’s for each other or our customers, we put People First. When our people come together, we Expand the Possible and continuously look for ways to improve what we create and how we do it. If you are constantly striving to grow, you’re in good company. We are revolutionizing the way the world moves for future generations, and we want someone who is ready to move with us.

**Who are we?**

Wabtec Corporation is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added services for freight and transit rail as well as the mining, marine, and industrial markets. Drawing on nearly four centuries of collective experience across Wabtec, GE Transportation, and Faiveley Transport, the company has grown to become One Wabtec, with unmatched digital expertise, technological innovation, and world-class manufacturing and services, enabling the digital-rail-and-transit ecosystems.  
  
Wabtec is focused on performance that drives progress and unlocks our customers’ potential by delivering innovative and lasting transportation solutions that move and improve the world. We are lifelong learners obsessed with making things better to drive exceptional results. Wabtec has approximately 27K employees in facilities throughout the world. Visit our website to learn more!

*Summary:*

The Staff Technical Product Manager supports the structured execution, adoption, and expansion of Data, Analytics, and Artificial Intelligence initiatives. The role works across product, business, engineering, infrastructure, and operational stakeholders to translate agreed product direction into organized backlogs, coordinated delivery routines, documented decisions, transparent progress, user feedback, effective communications, and transition readiness.

The position helps teams scale capabilities already built by improving reuse, documentation, communication, adoption, and expansion readiness. It also supports new initiatives by coordinating discovery activities, workshops, stakeholder inputs, feedback, dependencies, and follow-through.

To be successful in this role, you should have a strong background in Data & AI strategy definition and implementation, coupled with excellent leadership and communication skills. Experience in people management and a deep understanding of the business and technology landscape are also highly desirable.

If you are a strategic thinker, a passionate advocate for Data & AI innovation, and a collaborative leader, this Director of AI Strategy role presents an exciting opportunity to drive the organization's digital transformation and shape the future of its AI capabilities.

*Duties and Responsibilities:*

1. Operate a consistent product and delivery cadence across assigned initiatives, including backlog reviews, Sprint planning, daily or regular Scrum meetings, demonstrations, retrospectives, project reviews, and dependency discussions.

2. Maintain product and initiative backlogs in coordination with portfolio leadership, Product Owners, Engineering Managers, and technical leads, ensuring that items are clear, traceable, prioritized through the agreed process, and ready for execution.

3. Coordinating with Engineering Managers and technical leads to track delivery progress against agreed backlog items, milestones, acceptance criteria, risks, dependencies, and documented decisions.

4. Ensure progress visibility for infrastructure, platform, data, security, and other enabling initiatives by aggregating updates from responsible owners and highlighting significant dependencies or risks

5. Organize and facilitate discovery, product, business, and engineering workshops after the product vision and strategic direction have been established; prepare objectives and pre-work, coordinate participants, capture decisions, and track actions.

6. Plan user demonstrations, feedback sessions, testing discussions, and adoption reviews; document feedback, structure themes, route inputs to the appropriate owners, and track agreed responses.

7. Help scale capabilities already delivered by coordinating reusable documentation, playbooks, templates, user guidance, communication materials, knowledge transfer, adoption actions, and expansion readiness.

8. Prepare presentations, portfolio updates, meeting packs, agendas, pre-reads, decision logs, status summaries, and stakeholder communications based on agreed product and portfolio direction.

9. Keep product and initiative documentation accurate and up to date, covering requirements, assumptions, acceptance criteria, decisions, open questions, ownership, dependencies, lessons learned, handover details, and evidence of benefits.

10. Coordinate transition and operational readiness, ensuring that documentation, support ownership, user readiness, training inputs, communication, and post-implementation follow-up are planned and tracked.

*Minimum Qualifications:* (To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily.)

* University degree or the equivalent combination of education and experience required.
* This position requires a minimum of 7 -10 years’ experience, with hands on experience in the Data & AI Product Management and project management area

*Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:*

* A good understanding of various Data platforms, Cloud or on-prem (Datalake, DWH, Datamarts, Document management, Data interoperability (ETL, API mgt)
* Abilities to define a data & AI platform as a service for enabling other IT teams to benefit from it.

* 7-10 years of overall professional experience in product management, technology program management, digital delivery, data and analytics, business transformation, product operations, or a related field.
* At least 2-3 years of experience in a comparable Product Manager, Product Operations, Agile Program, or technology delivery coordination role.
* Experience running Agile or Scrum ceremonies and maintaining backlogs across one or more business and technology initiatives.
* Experience coordinating Engineering Managers, technical leads, developers, business stakeholders, infrastructure teams, and users in a matrixed environment.
* Experience tracking progress, risks, dependencies, milestones, decisions, and actions across concurrent initiatives.
* Experience facilitating workshops, demonstrations, feedback sessions, planning discussions, and cross-functional working meetings.
* Experience preparing clear presentations, status reports, pre-reads, decision materials, process documentation, and user-facing communications.
* Experience supporting adoption, transition, knowledge transfer, reuse, standardization, or expansion of technology-enabled capabilities.
* Working knowledge of Data, Analytics, Artificial Intelligence, digital products, cloud or infrastructure initiatives, and responsible technology delivery practices.
* Demonstrated ability to influence follow-through without direct authority while respecting product, portfolio, and engineering accountabilities.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and adapt to changing business priorities.

*Physical Demands and Work Environment:*

* This position is one that would normally require the person to work in a temperature-controlled office environment with other professional and management employees and continent workers, with frequent exposure to electronic office equipment.
* This position will require the employee to maintain hours during a typical day to overlap with team members and business users around the world with special attention to people in the time zones of India, Paris, and the Eastern U.S.
* This position will likely require the employee to travel a few times annually to physically meet with managers or team members.

*About You*

* You bring structure and momentum to complex initiatives without adding unnecessary process.
* You are confident facilitating Scrum ceremonies and product discussions with Engineering Managers, technical leads, senior developers, business stakeholders, and users.
* You can convert product direction and workshop discussions into clear backlog items, decisions, requirements, actions, and communication materials.
* You are highly organized and comfortable managing multiple timelines, dependencies, risks, decisions, and stakeholder commitments.
* You communicate clearly in writing and verbally and can prepare concise, leadership-ready presentations and pre-read materials.
* You listen carefully to users, separate observations from requirements, document feedback objectively, and support evidence-based prioritization.
* You can challenge missing information, unclear ownership, delayed actions, or unmanaged dependencies constructively and respectfully.
* You understand the difference between tracking engineering progress and managing technical quality or individual developer performance.
* You are motivated by scalable outcomes and help teams reuse, document, communicate, adopt, and expand capabilities already built.
* You are a collaborative self-starter who works within agreed portfolio strategy and product vision while taking ownership of execution discipline and follow-through.

**Our Commitment to Embrace Diversity:**

Wabtec is a global company that invests not just in our products, but also our people by embracing diversity and inclusion. We care about our relationships with our employees and take pride in celebrating the variety of experiences, expertise, and backgrounds that bring us together. At Wabtec, we aspire to create a place where we all belong and where diversity is welcomed and appreciated.

To fulfill that commitment, we rely on a culture of leadership, diversity, and inclusion. We aim to employ the world’s brightest minds to help us create a limitless source of ideas and opportunities. We have created a space where everyone is given the opportunity to contribute based on their individual experiences and perspectives and recognize that these differences and diverse perspectives make us better.

We believe in hiring talented people of varied backgrounds, experiences, and styles… People like you! Wabtec Corporation is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or expression, or protected Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

 **Additional Information**

**What could you accomplish in a place that puts People First?**

At Wabtec, it’s not just about a job - it’s about the impact you make. When our people come together, we’re Expanding the Possible by continuously improving what we do and how we do it - for our clients and each other.

If you’re ready to revolutionize how the world moves for future generations, Wabtec is the place for you.

**Who are we?**

Wabtec is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added services for the freight and transit rail sectors. Drawing on more than 150 years of experience, we are leading the way in safety, efficiency, reliability, innovation, and productivity. Whether it’s freight, transit, ports, logistics, mining, industrial, or marine, our expertise, technologies, and people together – are accelerating the future of transportation. With roots that date back to George Westinghouse, Thomas Edison, and Louis Faiveley, Wabtec has always built technologies and implemented solutions for a variety of sectors that are critical to meeting the needs of customers and governments alike.

Our global team of about 30,000 employees worldwide delivers performance that moves the world forward. We’re lifelong learners, obsessed with better. Learn more at www.WabtecCorp.com.

**Culture powers us and the possibilities.**

We believe the best ideas come from a mix of experiences and backgrounds. At Wabtec, we strive every day to create a place where everyone belongs. We’re building a culture where leadership, inclusion and your unique perspective fuel progress.

We’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome talent of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including race, gender, age, disability, veteran status and more.

Need accommodation? Just let us know - we’ve got you.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager - Cloudera Manager
job_description:
**Business Area:**

Product Mgmt.

**Seniority Level:**

Mid-Senior level

**Job Description:**

At Cloudera, we empower people to transform complex data into clear and actionable insights. With as much data under management as the hyperscalers, we're the preferred data partner for the top companies in almost every industry. Powered by the relentless innovation of the open source community, Cloudera advances digital transformation for the world’s largest enterprises.

Cloudera is seeking a Senior Product Manager for the Cloudera Manager product. This role owns the product strategy and roadmap for one of the key lifecycle management tools serving the largest global enterprises across all industries including finance, manufacturing, tech and federal. Cloudera Manager is responsible for the lifecycle of mission critical clusters with thousands of nodes and petabytes of data.

In this role, you will lead and execute on a strategy to ensure Cloudera Manager provides enterprise capabilities with the ease of data SaaS products from on-premises to cloud. You will grow Cloudera Manager to be a tool once used by engineers to an experience that is straight forward for any data platform manager. You will partner closely with Engineering, PMO, Product Marketing, and Field organizations to deliver a market-leading experience in hybrid cloud.

**As a Senior Product Manager you will:**

* **Drive Intelligent Product Experiences:** Shift the product strategy from infinite customization to a simplified user experience that provides optimal settings no matter the cluster configuration and active guardrails to eliminate operational fragility to prevent self-inflicted outages. Incorporate configuration recommendations, actionable health alerts, and actionable bad-configuration warnings directly into the product using AI trained on Cloudera’s knowledge base and real-time observability telemetry.
* **Simplify Accessibility for IT Generalists:** Design intuitive workflows and self-guided administrative tools tailored for IT generalists with minimal big data expertise, making documentation a secondary resource and lowering the barrier to platform management.
* **Embed Intelligence:** **Execute Hybrid Architecture Modernization:** Lead the long-term evolution of Cloudera Manager into an orchestrator of clusters across multiple clouds allowing customers to deploy use cases in a hybrid cloud topology.
* **Achieve Uninterrupted Core Operations at Scale:** Optimize fundamental cluster lifecycle operations to manage environments up to 10,000 nodes, ensuring refresh and maintenance operations on 1,000+ node clusters execute within customer approved SLAs.
* **Define Predictable Lifecycle & API Guarantees:** Establish and enforce structured release lifecycle policies that guarantee public API stability and backward compatibility to remove upgrade friction for enterprise customers.
* **Track Operational Success Metrics:** Monitor and continuously improve key performance indicators, specifically focusing on increasing operational velocity, boosting prescriptive feature adoption rates, and reducing support escalation volumes.

**We are excited if you have:**

  

* Bsc/Msc in related field or equivalent experience
* **Enterprise Platform Experience:** 5+ years of experience in the enterprise software space with at least 2 years of Product Management experience. Strong foundational understanding of open datalakes, data movement, enterprise data governance, and big data architecture.
* **On-Premise Knowledge:** Basic technical understanding of virtualization, data center networking
* **Public Cloud Knowledge:** Basic technical understanding of VM-based public cloud deployments (IaaS/PaaS), object storage architectures (S3, ADLS, GCS), and network architectures for at least one major hyperscaler (AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform).
* **Simplification & UX Modernization:** Demonstrated success in transforming complex, developer-centric platforms into intuitive, "opinionated" products with active guardrails that eliminate manual operational friction.

**You might also have:**

* **CSP Partner Ecosystem Experience:** Direct experience working with or within major cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP), including partner co-development, cloud marketplace programs, or cloud-native integrations.
* **Competitive Landscape Awareness:** Strong knowledge of modern cloud data platforms and competitive solutions, such as Databricks, Snowflake, Google BigQuery/Bigtable, Amazon EMR/Redshift, or Azure Synapse.
* **Modern Datalakehouse Formats:** Familiarity with open table formats (e.g., Apache Iceberg) and multi-cloud data architecture strategies.
* **Data Platform Administrative Experience:** Strong background with managing enterprise platforms or supporting customers running enterprise scale deployments with over 100 Terabytes of data.

**What you can expect from us:**

* Generous PTO Policy
* Support work life balance with Unplugged Days
* Flexible WFH Policy
* Mental & Physical Wellness programs
* Phone and Internet Reimbursement program
* Access to Continued Career Development
* Comprehensive Benefits and Competitive Packages
* Paid Volunteer Time
* Employee Resource Groups

EEO/VEVRAA

title: Technical Product Manager - Principal
job_description:
**Senior Product Manager / Solutions Architect – Design Automation & AI Workflows**
===================================================================================

**Company Overview**  
Siemens EDA is a global technology leader in Electronic Design Automation software. Our software tools enable companies around the world to develop highly innovative electronic products faster and more cost-effectively. Our customers use our tools to push the boundaries of technology and physics to deliver better products in the increasingly complex world of chip, board, and system design.

**Want to Help Shape How Chips Are Designed in the Future?**

* How would you automate workflows that have traditionally required years of engineering expertise?
* How would you combine AI, optimization, and domain knowledge to solve challenging problems across analog, custom digital, and standard cell design?
* How would you help customers migrate decades of intellectual property between design environments?
* How would you create products that make engineers dramatically more productive while improving design quality?
* How would you take breakthrough ideas from concept to deployment at the world's leading semiconductor companies?

That's what we do. We're looking for people who are excited about solving difficult problems and making a meaningful impact. You'll work at the intersection of semiconductor design, AI, product strategy, and customer engagement. The ideal candidate understands complex design challenges, can translate customer needs into product requirements, and enjoys helping bring innovative technologies from concept to production.

**Responsibilities**

* Define product requirements and workflows for next-generation design automation solutions.
* Work directly with customers to understand challenges, identify opportunities, and validate proposed solutions.
* Drive product direction for technologies across analog design, standard cell design, custom digital implementation, design migration, and design automation.
* Partner closely with engineering teams to translate customer needs into product capabilities and deliverables.
* Define use cases, success metrics, benchmarks, and customer adoption strategies.
* Lead evaluations, demonstrations, customer engagements, and early-access deployments.
* Influence roadmap priorities based on market needs, customer feedback, and competitive analysis.

**Requirements**

* BS, MS, or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline.
* Experience in semiconductor design, EDA, or related technical fields.
* Experience defining solutions, workflows, or products that have been successfully delivered to users or customers.
* Experience applying automation, AI, machine learning, generative AI, or agentic AI technologies to engineering workflows.
* Strong understanding of one or more of the following domains:
  + Analog and custom IC design
  + Standard cell design and optimization
  + Physical implementation
  + Design migration and design reuse
  + Semiconductor design automation
  + Physical verification, extraction, and simulation workflows
* Experience working directly with customers to gather requirements and drive technology adoption.
* Strong communication, presentation, and collaboration skills.
* Ability to work effectively across product management, engineering, sales, and customer teams.

**Preferred Experience**

* Analog and custom IC design workflows.
* Circuit simulation, SPICE, and analog verification flows.
* DRC, LVS, parasitic extraction, and physical verification.
* OpenAccess-based design environments.
* Experience with commercial EDA platforms such as Cadence Virtuoso.
* Delivering software products used in production semiconductor design flows.
* Technical leadership and cross-functional collaboration.

We are looking for product leaders who are excited by emerging technology, enjoy solving complex problems, and want to help shape the future of semiconductor design. Success in this role requires a combination of technical depth, customer focus, business judgment, and the ability to turn innovative ideas into widely adopted solutions.

**Why us?**  
Working at Siemens Software means flexibility — choosing between working at home and the office (with state-of-the-art facilities in Bangalore and Noida) at other times is the norm here. We offer great benefits and rewards, as you'd expect from a world leader in industrial software.

A collection of over 377,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday
